Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. The resulting rankings depend strongly on what is measured: no model leads on all ten, and across model means, higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89). RigidBench also includes 5,000 training videos with exact simulator state, which we use to fine-tune and analyze Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Full fine-tuning reduces 3D trajectory error by about 20% with almost no change in SSIM, while teacher-forced probes and targeted interventions show that object position is represented throughout Wan's diffusion transformer and used by its denoising computation.

</details>


### [88] [Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15574)
*Yogesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇工作解决视频问答中的“带时间戳但不一定真实”的幻觉问题：先生成答案，再用独立验证器复核引用帧。实验表明，NLI式小模型比直接问视觉模型或用通用LLM裁判更稳、更准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的视频问答系统会在没有真实证据支撑时，仍然生成看似有依据、带时间戳且高置信度的错误断言。这种“欺骗性幻觉”会因为时间戳营造出的grounding感而误导用户，但并不提升准确率，因此需要一个能真正核验引用帧是否支持答案的机制。

Method: 提出一个检索增强的语言模型生成管线：先由RAG式语言模型生成带逐条时间戳引用的答案，再对每个被引用的帧单独复核。作者比较了朴素基线与三种验证设计，并在 Apple Silicon（MLX）与 Google Colab（HF Transformers, CUDA）上做了消融评估。验证方案包括：直接让视觉模型判定支持关系、重描述后交由通用LLM裁决、以及使用小型NLI模型进行判断。

Result: 直接询问视觉模型某帧是否支持某个断言，40条样本上捕获率为0%，表现出明显的sycophancy。使用盲重描述加通用LLM裁判后，效果不稳定，受提示词影响在0%与100%标注为错误之间波动。改用小型NLI模型后，验证器稳定且可解释，在对抗性反事实问题上可捕获79%的伪造断言，同时不误伤真实断言。

Conclusion: 该论文认为，单靠带时间戳的引用并不能保证视频问答答案真实可靠；通过“先生成、再逐条核验”的闭环流程，结合自然语言推理模型作为验证器，可以显著提升对伪造答案的识别能力并保持稳定性。

Abstract: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phrasing. Replacing that judge with a small natural language inference model yields a stable, interpretable verifier that catches 79% of fabricated claims on adversarial false-premise questions while leaving true claims untouched. We release the full pipeline, evaluation harness, and implementations for both Apple Silicon and Colab. Code is available at https://github.com/yogesh-iitj/grounded-video-qa.

</details>


### [89] [PoseAdapter: Dual-Stream 2.5D Controllable Image Generation for Complex Multi-Object Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15583)
*Yufeng Chi,Huimin Ma,Fan Gao,Zhice Niu,Keqin Li,Jianmin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇工作提出了一个轻量级的2.5D可控生成框架，用更简单的条件布局和双流表示来解决多物体场景中的位置、朝向与属性泄漏问题，并在新数据集上取得更好的生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2I 扩散模型在多物体场景中难以实现精确空间与朝向控制；稠密3D地图方案计算代价高，而其他方法容易出现属性泄漏和“剪贴感”伪影。

Method: 提出 PoseAdapter 框架：用单个对象描述、2D边界框和3D角度构建高效条件布局；并在现代 MM-DiT 架构中通过并行的 masked / unmasked 双路径，将局部对象 token 与关系增强的场景 token 注入视觉流，以兼顾实例隔离和全局一致性。

Result: 作者构建了 OrientLayout 数据集，包含标准化的2.5D标注和实例级解耦语义；实验表明 PoseAdapter 在空间定位、朝向控制和多对象图像质量方面优于现有方法。

Conclusion: PoseAdapter 通过轻量级的2.5D条件布局与上下文感知双流表示，在多物体文本生成图像中同时提升空间准确性、朝向精度和多对象视觉保真度。

Abstract: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, precise spatial and orientational control in multi-object scenes remains a persistent challenge. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive dense 3D maps or suffer from severe attribute leakage and "cut-and-paste" artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose PoseAdapter, a lightweight framework for high-fidelity 2.5D controllable image generation. Instead of dense spatial maps, it establishes precise spatial-angular anchors using an efficient condition layout: individual object captions, 2D bounding boxes, and 3D angles. To resolve the generative trade-off between strict instance isolation and global coherence, we introduce a Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation. By injecting local object tokens and relation-enriched scene tokens into the visual stream of modern MM-DiT architectures via parallel masked and unmasked pathways, PoseAdapter eliminates attribute leakage while preserving natural inter-object relationships and scene-level coherence. To support this paradigm, we construct OrientLayout, a high-quality dataset featuring standardized 2.5D annotations and instance-level decoupled semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseAdapter outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in spatial accuracy, orientational precision, and multi-object visual fidelity. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/cyf23/PoseAdapter.

</details>


### [90] [AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15605)
*Kuan-Lin Chen,Tzu-Ti Wei,Chao-Chi Liao,Yu-Chee Tseng,Jen-Jee Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文针对 VLM 的空间理解歧义问题，提出了一个带有 allocentric/egocentric 视角标注的新数据集 AlloEgo-View，以及可直接微调接入现有模型的 AlloEgo-VLM，用来更准确地解析空间参考框架并提升机器人场景中的目标搜索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在空间语义理解上容易因自然语言省略参考框架而产生歧义，且由于训练中对参考框架与物体朝向覆盖不足，面对视角相关查询时输出不一致，进而可能导致具身 AI 机器人出现严重错误。

Method: 构建 AlloEgo-View 数据集，包含 (image, query, view-specific answer) 三元组，并用结构化空间表示标注场景描述、参考/目标物体、方向、参考框架和视角类型；在此基础上设计 AlloEgo-VLM，用于区分 allocentric 与 egocentric 参考框架，并通过监督微调适配现有 VLM；最后在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的具身机器人平台上进行开放式目标搜索任务验证。

Result: 实验表明，当前 VLM 在处理 view-specific 查询时存在明显局限；相比之下，AlloEgo-VLM 展现出较强的消歧能力，并在具身机器人任务中验证了其实用性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的 AlloEgo-View 数据集与 AlloEgo-VLM 框架能够有效缓解 VLM 在空间语义理解中的歧义问题，尤其是在 allocentric 与 egocentric 参考框架混淆时表现出更强的消歧能力，并可通过监督微调无缝集成到现有 VLM 中。

Abstract: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.

</details>


### [91] [EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15614)
*Matteo Stoiber,Niels Buus Lassen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出了一个可在设备端实时运行的轻量凝视预测器 EgoGazeLite，用软件替代眼动硬件，为第一视角视频的凝视裁剪提供等效效果，并显著降低多模态大模型处理视频的 token 和计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向第一视角视频理解的多模态大模型受视觉 token 预算限制，高分辨率视频带来高昂的传输与推理成本；已有方法依赖眼动追踪硬件，但消费级智能眼镜通常不具备这一能力，因此需要一种仅靠软件、且能在设备端实时运行的凝视预测替代方案。

Method: 提出 EgoGazeLite，一种轻量级双过程（dual-process）凝视预测器，用于第一视角视频中的凝视估计与基于凝视的裁剪。该方法在消费级加速硬件上端到端运行，将预测出的凝视区域用于视频裁剪，并与真实凝视裁剪在多个 MLLM、自动指标和 LLM 评审上进行对比。

Result: 在两个 MLLM、三项自动指标和两个 LLM 评审中，预测凝视裁剪与真实凝视裁剪之间均无显著差异，十项对比全部达到等效；模型规模为 15.7M 参数、6.71 GFLOPs，端到端延迟 21.6 ms/帧，可实时运行。

Conclusion: EgoGazeLite 证明了无需眼动硬件也能实现 token 高效、凝视条件化的第一视角视频理解，从而消除了该类系统对专用眼动追踪设备的依赖。

Abstract: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.

</details>


### [92] [Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15647)
*Shuaishuai Cao,Meng Tang,Shuwei Peng,Xuan Liu,Min Huang,Jie Chen,Jiacheng Niu,Yong Chen,Edore Akpokodje,Hui Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出HAFR-Net，用自适应多阶段融合、频率残差适配和三重先验解码器，来更稳健地利用预训练层级特征做VHR遥感语义分割，并取得了稳定的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强预训练层级编码器虽有优势，但多阶段表示难以有效利用：不同区域需要不同的细节/语义平衡；激进的任务特定变换会破坏预训练特征；常规语义监督对结构信息的约束不足。

Method: 提出三部分框架：1) Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion（HG-SAF），根据局部特征变化预测稠密的stage权重，自适应融合多阶段表示；2) Frequency-Residual Adapter（FRA），通过零初始化、受限残差分支注入频率信息，同时保留融合特征作为参考；3) Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder（CATP），结合边界、目标性和由训练数据得到的类别关系先验进行预测正则化。

Result: 在匹配的Swin-B训练和单尺度推理设置下，HAFR-Net在ISPRS Vaihingen、ISPRS Potsdam、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap上分别达到84.12%、87.86%、55.17%和67.70%的mIoU，较匹配的UPerNet基线提升0.55、0.95、1.55和1.84个百分点；消融分析表明其具备更一致的空间重加权、更好的边界与细长结构识别，以及更少的预设类别对混淆。

Conclusion: HAFR-Net通过渐进式、保守式地组织和细化层级表征，而非用单一解码器重写特征，在VHR遥感语义分割上优于匹配基线，并在边界、细结构和类别混淆方面表现更好。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference. A Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder (CATP) finally regularizes the prediction with boundary, objectness, and training-derived class-relation cues. Under a matched Swin-B training and single-scale inference protocol, HAFR-Net attains 84.12%, 87.86%, 55.17%, and 67.70% mIoU on ISPRS Vaihingen, ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap, improving the matched UPerNet baseline by 0.55, 0.95, 1.55, and 1.84 percentage points, respectively. Controlled analyses further show consistent spatial reweighting beyond content-only routing, improved boundary and thin-structure accuracy over matched spatial and spectral alternatives, and reduced confusion on pre-declared class pairs.

</details>


### [93] [Gaussian-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15651)
*Bin Ren,Qi Ma,Yue Li,Zongyan Han,Yidi Li,Yuqian Fu,Rao Muhammad Anwer,Theo Gevers,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gaussian-JEPA，用 latent prediction 学习 3D Gaussian 表征，避免重建式预训练对单一采样和输入解码器的依赖，在一致性、信息保留和下游迁移上优于重建基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 自监督方法主要重建被遮挡的 Gaussian 属性，这会把监督绑定到某一种采样实现，并且需要输入空间解码器；而 Gaussian token 的属性耦合且空间支持异质，适合用 latent prediction 代替重建。

Method: 提出 Gaussian-JEPA：在线编码器处理可见上下文，共享的 EMA 编码器为多尺度目标提供 stop-gradient 特征；再通过互补的目标投影和特征空间对齐，在不重建 Gaussian 属性的前提下对被遮挡 token 块做潜在空间预测。

Result: 实验表明，Gaussian-JEPA 学到的特征在 Gaussian 重采样下更一致，在部分观察下保留更多实例信息，并且对 renderable shape completion 提供更强的冻结特征；同时对 part segmentation 和 object classification 的迁移也更有效。

Conclusion: Gaussian-JEPA 通过预测被遮挡的 Gaussian token 块的潜在表示，能够学到更稳定、可迁移的 3D Gaussian 表征；相比匹配的重建式预训练，它在重采样一致性、部分可见条件下的信息保留以及冻结特征用于 Gaussian completion 方面都更强。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents 3D content with anisotropic primitives that jointly encode geometry and appearance. Fixed-budget encoders consume sampled observations of Gaussian assets, so the same object may be observed through different primitive realizations. Existing self-supervised methods mainly reconstruct masked Gaussian attributes, tying supervision to one sampled realization and requiring an input-space decoder. Latent prediction offers an alternative, but its application to Gaussian tokens requires targets that accommodate coupled attributes and heterogeneous spatial support. We introduce Gaussian-JEPA, which predicts representations of held-out Gaussian token blocks from visible context. An online encoder processes the context, while a shared exponential-moving-average encoder supplies stop-gradient features for multi-scale targets. Complementary target projections and feature-space grounding provide latent supervision without reconstructing Gaussian attributes. We evaluate the features under Gaussian resampling, partial observations, and renderable shape completion, together with transfer to part segmentation and object classification. Compared with matched reconstruction pretraining, Gaussian-JEPA is more consistent across resampled inputs, retains more instance information under partial observations, and provides stronger frozen features for Gaussian completion. These results support latent prediction as an effective objective for reusable 3D Gaussian representations. Code is on the project page (https://amazingren.github.io/Gaussian-JEPA/).

</details>


### [94] [Scalable Black-Box Model Attribution for Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15652)
*Asaf Livne,Amir Jevnisek,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出一个很简单但很强的黑盒模型归因方法RPA：用轻量CNN看原始patch，就能准确判断图片来自哪个生成模型，并且学到的表示还能泛化到未知模型和少样本新模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型快速普及后，出现了模型归因问题：只给定一张图像，能否判断它由哪个生成模型产生。现有方法往往越来越复杂，作者质疑“更强的生成器必须对应更复杂的归因器”这一假设。

Method: 提出 Raw-Patch Attribution (RPA)：在严格黑盒设置下，仅使用图像的原始局部patch训练一个轻量级CNN进行模型归因；通过闭集归因训练得到通用特征提取器，并将该表示用于闭集、无监督线索恢复、未知模型聚类和少样本适配。

Result: RPA在多个基准上取得更高准确率：DRAGON 25类达到98.0%，OpenFake 27类达到92.9%；同时具备数据效率高、推理成本与候选模型数量无关、对压缩/模糊/缩放等真实退化鲁棒的特点。

Conclusion: 作者表明，模型归因不需要依赖复杂方法；一个轻量级CNN在严格黑盒条件下即可高效、准确地识别生成图像的来源模型，并且所学表示还能迁移到无监督归因、未知模型分组和少样本新模型适配等任务。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative models raises the model attribution problem: given only an image, can we determine which model produced it? Existing methods have grown as elaborate as the generators they target, on the as- sumption that a more sophisticated model demands a more sophisticated attributor. We show it does not. RPA (Raw- Patch Attribution) attributes images in the strictest black- box setting with a lightweight CNN. Despite its simplicity, it attributes more models at higher accuracy than prior work, reaching 98.0% on 25-class DRAGON and 92.9% on 27- class OpenFake; it is data-efficient and runs at a cost inde- pendent of the number of candidate models; and it stays ro- bust to the compression, blur, and resizing images undergo in the wild. Training for closed-set attribution yields a ver- satile feature extractor: the same representation recovers model lineage without supervision, flags and groups unseen generators, and admits new models through few-shot adap- tation rather than retraining.

</details>


### [95] [WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15659)
*Xiaojie Xu,Zhengyuan Lin,Runyi Li,Yihao Liu,Kaipeng Zhang,Yongtao Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldRover是一个基于Unreal Engine的长时程世界探索数据引擎与10M级数据集，能在同一探索轨迹上同时输出多视角RGB、深度、轨迹、动作以及第三人称下的光流和长程点轨迹，用于训练可探索世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习生成或重建可探索世界的模型，不仅需要视频，还需要相机运动、几何、时序对应关系以及交互控制信号。真实采集很难同时稳定获得这些监督，而现有合成数据通常不能在同一帧上同时提供这些信息，也缺少可控视角与外观变化。

Method: 作者构建了基于Unreal Engine的WorldRover-Engine，能够离线渲染分钟级路线，并保留完整轨迹与场景几何；同一条探索可从第一人称、第三人称和360全景视角重放，并在不同环境状态或白模材质下渲染。基于此，生成了WorldRover-10M，包含RGB、度量深度、相机轨迹、轨迹派生动作信号；第三人称子集额外包含稠密光流、长程2D/3D点轨迹及可见性、以及与相机轨迹分离的角色轨迹。

Result: 该工作提供了一个可扩展的数据生成方案和大规模数据集，使长程世界探索问题可转化为数据生成问题，并为需要构建、维持和回访一致世界表征的模型提供监督。

Conclusion: WorldRover提出了一个用于生成长时程、可探索世界数据的新型数据引擎与数据集，重点在于同一条探索轨迹上同时提供RGB、深度、相机轨迹以及更丰富的第三人称监督信号。

Abstract: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.

</details>


### [96] [BASeg: Boundary-Aware Remote Sensing Segmentation with Structural Penalties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15683)
*Yuexi Song,Kailai Sun,Zhuoyu Wang,Mingyi He,Paul Pu Liang,Shenhao Wang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个面向遥感分割的边界感知方法 BASeg。核心是 MABL 边界损失，配合全局上下文与局部特征融合模块，能更好地分割建筑和道路，尤其提升边界质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感语义分割方法往往难以捕捉细粒度目标特征和边界细节；常用数据集缺乏城市形态多样性；生成图像上的分割研究也相对不足，因此需要一种更关注边界与结构的分割方法和更具多样性的数据集。

Method: 提出 Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss（MABL），结合基于 Mahalanobis 距离的结构重要性加权与角度感知惩罚，显式增强边界和形状一致性；在此基础上构建 BASeg 框架，包含用于捕获长程依赖的 Global Visual State Space module（GSM）和用于融合细粒度局部信息的 Cross-Feature Fusion module（CFM）；同时建立 GCD-25k 全球10城市数据集用于建筑物和道路分割。

Result: 在四个遥感基准上，BASeg 的 mIoU 最多提升 2.8%；生成的分割结果边界更准确；将 MABL 插入多种现有分割架构后，在不同数据集上都能稳定提升性能，说明其鲁棒性和广泛适用性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的 BASeg 与 MABL 能显著提升遥感语义分割的边界与形状一致性，在多个基准上均优于现有方法，并证明了该边界损失具有良好的通用性。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation is a core computer vision task in the remote sensing field, accelerating advancements in ur- ban development, agriculture, ecology, water resources, and environmental monitoring. However, recent methods usually struggle to capture fine-grained object features and bound- ary details. Besides, current widely used datasets often lack city morphology diversity and segmentation on generative im- ages remains largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL) that explicitly enhances boundary and shape consistency. MABL jointly models structural importance and boundary orientation through Mahalanobis distance-based weighting and angle- aware penalty. It can be readily integrated into diverse seg- mentation architectures and consistently improves their accu- racy. Built upon MABL, we introduce BASeg, a boundary- aware remote sensing segmentation framework with Struc- tural Penalties. BASeg integrates a Global Visual State Space module (GSM) with a Cross-Feature Fusion module (CFM) to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine- grained local details. Additionally, we establish a global 10- city benchmark dataset (GCD-25k) to facilitate accurate build- ing and road segmentation. Extensive experiments on four remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate that BASeg consis- tently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 2.8% improvement in mIoU while producing more accurate object boundary segmentation across diverse scenes. Moreover, integrating MABL into multiple existing segmentation archi- tectures consistently improves performance across datasets, demonstrating its robustness and broad applicability.

</details>


### [97] [PixelControl: Fine-Grained Condition Fidelity in Text-to-Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15705)
*Xin Lin,Haodong Li,Zhifei Zhang,Yutong Yang,Haitian Zheng,Juanxi Tian,Zhe Lin,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixelControl把可控扩散从潜空间搬到像素空间，并用结构感知注入+多尺度循环损失强化细粒度条件遵循，从而更好地保住边界和小目标细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控文生图扩散模型通常能遵循全局布局，但在对象边界、细薄轮廓以及中小条件区域上仍容易失真；这一问题在基于VAE的潜空间扩散中更严重，因为空间压缩会削弱高频和小面积条件信号，因此需要更强的细粒度结构保真能力。

Method: 提出PixelControl框架，基于PixelDiT风格的像素空间骨干网络，避免VAE潜空间压缩带来的细节损失；设计了两项核心机制：1）Structure-Aware Control Injection，从条件中提取结构图并在空间敏感区域增强控制残差；2）Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss，在多分辨率下将生成图像与条件结构进行一致性约束；同时通过模态专用控制分支与轻量门控融合支持深度、分割、边缘及其组合条件。

Result: 实验在深度、分割和边缘控制任务上表明，PixelControl相较现有可控生成方法具有更好的结构一致性和视觉质量，尤其在边界和中小区域上提升明显。

Conclusion: PixelControl通过像素空间建模、结构感知控制注入和多尺度金字塔循环损失，显著提升了可控文生图在边界、细轮廓以及中小区域上的结构保真度，并同时兼顾视觉质量。

Abstract: Controllable text-to-image diffusion models can often follow the global layout of spatial conditions, yet still violate fine-grained structures such as object boundaries, thin contours, and medium/small conditioned regions. This limitation is especially problematic for VAE-based latent diffusion, where spatial compression can weaken high-frequency and low-area condition signals. We propose PixelControl, a pixel-space controllable diffusion framework for fine-grained condition fidelity. Built on a PixelDiT-style backbone, PixelControl avoids the latent bottleneck and introduces two complementary designs. First, Structure-Aware Control Injection derives a condition structure map and uses it to strengthen injected control residuals around spatially sensitive regions. Second, Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss verifies generated images against condition-derived structures across multiple resolutions, balancing global layout consistency with local boundary and detail accuracy. PixelControl supports depth, segmentation, edge, and their combinations through modality-specific control branches with lightweight gated fusion. Experiments across depth, segmentation, and edge control show that PixelControl improves structural fidelity and visual quality over existing controllable generation methods, with especially strong gains on boundaries and medium/small conditioned regions. The project page can be found at: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/

</details>


### [98] [Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15710)
*Kohsuke Ide,Ryousuke Yamada,Yue Qiu,Xianzheng Ma,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Yutaka Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇工作补足了 3D-LLM 在多对象比较推理上的缺口：先做 MO3D 数据集，再用 PIT 结构训练 Multi-3DLLM，最后在多对象比较和实际几何任务上都取得明显提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D-LLM 主要聚焦单对象或场景描述，缺乏对多个对象之间细粒度比较与关系推理的能力，而这类能力对几何理解和实际应用至关重要。

Method: 构建 MO3D 多对象 3D 指令数据集，要求模型进行细粒度多对象比较；提出 Multi-3DLLM，采用最小化的 Patch-Interaction Transformer（PIT）来建模对象内与对象间关系，同时保留局部几何信息；并设计 Shape Mating 与 Change Captioning 两个应用型基准进行评测。

Result: 实验表明，现有 3D-LLM 和 2D-VLM 在这些比较驱动任务上表现较差；Multi-3DLLM 在 MO3D 上全面优于所有基线，并在单对象分类任务上也带来性能提升，说明其学到更强的几何推理能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的 Multi-3DLLM 通过面向多对象比较的训练数据与轻量交互建模模块，显著提升了 3D-LLM 的对象级几何推理能力，并且对单对象分类也有正向迁移。

Abstract: We address a fundamental gap in 3D-LLMs: existing models focus on single-object/scene description, struggling with detailed, inter-object comparison. We propose a framework for detailed object-level reasoning across multiple objects with three components: (1) MO3D (Multi-Object in 3D), an instruction dataset requiring fine-grained multi-object comparison; (2) Multi-3DLLM, using a minimal Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT) that models inter-/intra-object relationships while preserving local geometry; (3) Mini-apps, two application-driven benchmarks (Shape Mating, Change Captioning) that probe geometric understanding for practical use. Recent 3D-LLMs and 2D-VLMs perform poorly on these tasks, lacking both comparison-centric design and geometric awareness. In contrast, Multi-3DLLM trained on our mixture data learns geometric reasoning, surpasses all baselines on MO3D, and provides positive transfer to single-object classification.

</details>


### [99] [What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15708)
*Jinhwan Seo,Kyubeom Han,Jumin Lee,Junhyug Noh,Sung-eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文解决Grounded VideoQA里“同一视频不同问题却定位到相同片段”的问题，核心思路是先让视频特征真正受问题意图调制，再把答案选择、时序证据和跨模态对齐一起学，最终提升时序定位的可区分性和整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Grounded VideoQA存在一个被忽视的失败模式——question-invariant grounding，即模型对同一视频中的不同问题预测几乎相同的时间片段。作者认为其根源在于两点：视频表征在接收问题语义之前就被固定，以及定位模块中问题注入过弱。

Method: 提出GroundFormer：先用可学习通信token实现定向的视听交互，将问题语义注入视频特征；再在问题条件化特征上使用分解式MIL cross-attention，将答案选择与时序证据联合建模；通过Gaussian smoothing把尖锐注意力转为连续时序片段；最后采用分层多模态对比学习，并在两阶段训练管线中对齐视频、问题和答案表示。

Result: 在NExT-GQA和STAR数据集上，GroundFormer达到了最先进的Grounded VideoQA性能，并且显著改善了不同问题之间的时序定位区分性。

Conclusion: GroundFormer通过在定位前用问题意图条件化视频特征，并结合分解式MIL跨注意力、Gaussian平滑和分层多模态对比学习，显著提升了Grounded VideoQA中的问题可区分时序定位能力，在NExT-GQA和STAR上取得SOTA。

Abstract: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, which conditions video features on question intent before localization via learnable communication tokens that mediate directed visuo-lingual interaction. On top of the question-conditioned features, a factorized MIL cross-attention couples answer selection with temporal evidence under candidate-level supervision, while Gaussian smoothing converts peaked attention into temporally coherent segments. We further introduce a hierarchical multi-modal contrastive loss that aligns video, question, and answer embeddings across a two-pass training pipeline. GroundFormer achieves state-of-the-art grounded VideoQA performance on NExT-GQA and STAR, substantially improving question-discriminative temporal grounding.

</details>


### [100] [YOLO26-RD: An End-to-End Road Damage Detection Network With Learnable Contrast Enhancement and Edge-Guided Downsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15713)
*Sompote Youwai,Pawarotorn Chaipetch,Hathairat Samaikul,Theerayut Yonseng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文的核心结论是：路面病害检测不应默认按小目标问题处理。通过数据分析驱动地简化YOLO26-RD架构，作者在提升速度的同时获得了更好的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有路面病害检测通常被当作小目标检测问题，因此常采用高分辨率P2/4检测头和无损下采样；作者怀疑这一前提是否成立，希望通过数据审计验证病害的真实难点，并据此优化检测架构。

Method: 在YOLO26基础上构建YOLO26-RD，加入两个轻量模块：LearnableContrast（可学习的、按tile自适应对比度增强）和EdgeSPD（Sobel门控的space-to-depth下采样）；随后对7618张路面巡检图像进行数据优先审计，并根据病害尺度与形态特征调整检测头设计，最终去掉P2检测层但保留其在融合路径中的特征。

Result: 审计发现92%的实例属于COCO-large，线性裂缝更像极端长宽比结构而非传统小目标。去掉P2检测层后，mAP50提升2.8个百分点，epoch时间减少8%。最佳配置在验证集上达到0.787 mAP50，较0.771的基线更好；其中patching类别提升最明显。对crack类的剩余误差主要归因于训练/验证分布偏移、亚像素宽度和标注不完整，而非模型结构不足。

Conclusion: 对于路面病害检测，基于实测数据的结构删减比继续堆叠模块更有效；在该数据集上，移除P2检测层但保留P2特征融合可带来更好的精度与效率。

Abstract: Automated pavement-distress detection is commonly framed as a small-object problem, motivating high-resolution P2/4 detection heads and lossless downsampling. We present YOLO26-RD, an end-to-end (NMS-free) detector built on YOLO26 with two lightweight novel modules (LearnableContrast, a 494-parameter differentiable analogue of CLAHE that adapts contrast per tile inside the network, and EdgeSPD, a Sobel-gated space-to-depth downsampler adding only 2 parameters over SPD-Conv), and we subject the design to a data-first audit on a 7,618-image road-survey dataset (alligator crack, linear crack, patching). The audit falsifies the small-object premise: 92% of instances are COCO-large, and linear cracks are extreme-aspect structures (median 10:1) whose difficulty is sensitivity, not localization. Guided by this analysis, we remove the P2 detection level while retaining P2 features in the fusion path, which improves mAP50 by 2.8 points over the full YOLO26-RD model and reduces epoch time by 8%. Trained from scratch at 640x640, our best screening configuration reaches 0.787 mAP50 on the validation split versus a 0.771 project baseline (a stock YOLO26-s of uncontrolled recipe), with the largest per-class gain on the rarest class (patching, 2.6 points over baseline; 9.4 over the unmodified YOLO26-RD control under an identical recipe). A failure-mode decomposition further attributes the residual error of the bottleneck class (crack, approximately 0.74 across all architectures tested) to train/validation distribution shift on crack orientation and length, sub-pixel crack width at 640x640, and label incompleteness, factors no architecture change can address. We argue that for pavement imagery, measurement-driven subtraction outperforms module accretion, and we release our audit protocol alongside the model.

</details>


### [101] [Anatomical and Physical Supervision for CT-less PET Attenuation Correction: BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15721)
*Petros Chatzitoulousis,George K. Matsopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文面向 CT-less PET 衰减校正，基于 nnU-Net 结合解剖监督、可微分衰减物理损失和预训练权重，实现更好的伪 CT 合成与 PET 重建表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BIC-MAC 2026 挑战要求在无 CT 条件下进行 PET 衰减校正，需要从多模态信息中合成伪 CT。作者希望通过结合解剖信息与 PET 衰减物理约束，提高伪 CT 合成的真实感以及对最终 PET 校正的有效性。

Method: 以标准 nnU-Net 为基础，加入冻结的 TotalSegmentator 特征提取器、解剖结构约束与 patch 采样策略作为解剖监督；同时设计基于多角度衰减投影的可微分 attenuation correction factor 投影损失作为物理监督；并使用 SynthRAD Challenge 的 MR-to-CT 预训练权重初始化网络，配合预处理、plans 和监督设计等 nnU-Net 流程优化。

Result: 最终提交在保持架构改动很小的前提下，通过 nnU-Net 的整体优化、解剖监督和物理监督获得性能提升，证明了这些设计对 CT-less PET attenuation correction 的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将解剖先验、衰减物理约束与预训练 nnU-Net 结合，可以有效提升 CT-less PET 衰减校正中的伪 CT 质量及下游 PET 重建表现。

Abstract: This report describes our submission to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) 2026 Challenge for CT-less PET attenuation correction through multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis. We build upon a standard nnU-Net architecture and combine anatomical and physical supervision to improve both pseudo-CT quality and downstream PET reconstruction. Anatomical supervision is introduced through a frozen TotalSegmentator feature extractor, anatomy-guided structural constraints and patch sampling, while physical supervision is achieved using a differentiable attenuation correction factor projection loss based on multi-angle attenuation projections. Furthermore, the network is initialized with pretrained weights obtained from training on the SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT dataset. Minimal architectural modifications are applied, while performance improvements are pursued across the nnU-Net pipeline, including preprocessing, plans, and supervision design, among other components. Our final submission demonstrates the effectiveness of combining anatomical supervision, attenuation physics, and efficient nnU-Net scaling for CT-less PET attenuation correction.

</details>


### [102] [Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15869)
*Xiaoyu Zhu,Xinke Deng,Suresh Taddewadikar,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Zhongyu Jiang,Ian Fasel,Joerg Liebelt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IVT 用训练期的未来表示预测替代推理期的显式图像生成，让模型把视觉世界模型“内化”到参数里，从而在主动视频推理中同时提升准确率和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型使用 visual chain-of-thought 通过生成中间视觉推理图像来进行空间、时间和具身环境推理，但这种方式推理开销大，尤其不适合主动视频推理；作者希望模型能在训练中学会“视觉思考”，而在推理时直接作答。

Method: 提出 Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT) 后训练框架，在未标注视频上联合优化文本答案预测与下一帧嵌入预测；输入部分可见视频，训练时同时学习未来帧的潜在表示与目标文本答案，推理时直接生成答案而不再合成或重编码未来帧。

Result: 在六种评测设置上，IVT 都优于直接答案微调，并保持相同的推理路径；与显式 Visual CoT 相比，IVT 表现相当或更好，平均端到端延迟降低超过 5 倍。

Conclusion: IVT 证明了：视觉推理不必在推理时显式生成未来图像，也能通过训练阶段的潜在世界建模获得接近或更好的效果，并显著降低推理延迟。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

</details>


### [103] [Identifying Confusion Trends in Concept-based XAI for Multi-Label Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15731)
*Haadia Amjad,Ronald Tetzlaff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在 MS-COCO 多标签分类任务上比较 VGG16/ResNet50 与 CRP/CRAFT 两种概念解释方法，发现 CXAI 可用于识别模型弱点、降低概念混淆并揭示数据集偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险场景中的深度神经网络不仅需要准确，还必须具备可理解性以建立用户信任；而现实中的计算机视觉任务通常涉及复杂背景和大量标注，因此需要评估概念级可解释AI方法在多标签分类中的适用性和问题诊断能力。

Method: 在 MS-COCO 数据集中选取标注最丰富的 20 个标签，训练 VGG16 和 ResNet50 两个深度神经网络，并应用两种概念级解释方法 CRP（Concept Relevance Propagation）和 CRAFT（Concept Recursive Activation FacTorization）生成概念层面的解释，进而对模型表现与解释结果进行分析。

Result: 研究发现三点：1）CXAI 能揭示 DNN 的学习薄弱环节；2）更高的概念区分度可以减少标签与概念之间的混淆；3）环境类概念能够暴露由数据集引入的偏置。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，概念级可解释性方法（CXAI）不仅能帮助理解多标签视觉模型的决策机制，还能用于诊断模型学习弱点、概念混淆以及数据集偏置，提升对模型泛化能力的理解。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in high-risk domains, such as healthcare and autonomous driving, must be not only accurate but also understandable to ensure user trust. In real-world computer vision tasks, these models often operate on complex images containing background noise and are heavily annotated. To make such models explainable, Concept-based Explainable AI (CXAI) methods need to be assessed for their applicability and problem-solving capacity. In this work, we explore CXAI use cases in multi-label classification by training two DNNs, VGG16 and ResNet50, on the 20 most annotated labels in the MS-COCO dataset (Microsoft Common Objects in Context). We apply two CXAI methods, CRP (Concept Relevance Propagation) and CRAFT (Concept Recursive Activation FacTorization), to generate concept-level explanations and investigate the overall evaluations. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) CXAI highlights learning weaknesses in DNNs, (2) higher concept distinctiveness reduces label and concept confusion, and (3) environmental concepts expose dataset-induced biases. Our results demonstrate the potential of CXAI to enhance the understanding of model generalizability and to diagnose bias instigated by the dataset.

</details>


### [104] [ES3D: Embedding Semantics into 3D Space for Component-Aware Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15749)
*Xuancheng Jin,Rengan Xie,Jiayuan Lu,Wenting Zheng,Rui Wang,Yuchi Huo,Lincheng Li,Yingfeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ES3D 是一种把语义“写入”3D 空间的编辑框架：先找出可编辑组件，再用多张参考图像和可选文本对这些区域进行受控编辑，从而比传统文本驱动方法更细粒度、更稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 编辑方法多依赖文本驱动，难以表达细粒度视觉修改；很多方法还需要人工 3D mask，或会误改不该变化的区域。根本原因在于缺乏细粒度语义理解，导致模型难以定位和修改特定 3D 组件。

Method: 先将多视角语义特征投影到资产的体素化空间，构建 3D 语义嵌入；再通过计算 3D 语义嵌入与图像/文本查询语义嵌入的特征相似度，完成组件检索；编辑阶段使用带 inpainting 机制的预训练 3D 生成模型，在用户提供图像引导下修改检索到的组件，同时保留其余区域。

Result: 实验表明，ES3D 能生成几何一致、语义连贯的编辑结果，并且在图像驱动和文本辅助控制下都表现出较强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ES3D 通过将语义嵌入直接引入三维空间，实现了面向组件的检索与编辑；它支持基于多张局部参考图像并可选结合文本查询，对 3D 资产进行更细粒度、语义一致且几何一致的编辑。

Abstract: Existing 3D editing methods have made notable progress in controllability, yet they remain limited in several important ways. Most approaches rely on text-driven editing, which struggles to express fine-grained visual changes intended by the user. Moreover, many methods require manually supplied 3D masks or introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain untouched. These limitations largely arise from the absence of fine-grained semantic understanding, making it difficult for existing models to retrieve or modify specific 3D components.
  We introduce ES3D, a framework that embeds semantics directly into 3D space, enabling component-aware retrieval and editing of a 3D asset conditioned on multiple local reference images and optional text queries. We first construct a 3D semantic embedding by projecting multi-view semantic features into the voxelized space of the asset. We then perform 3D component retrieval by computing feature similarity between the 3D semantic embedding and the semantic embeddings of image or text queries. For editing, we employ a pretrained 3D generative model with an inpainting mechanism to modify the retrieved components guided by user-provided images while preserving the rest of the asset. Overall, ES3D is a 3D editing framework that retrieves editable regions based on semantic cues and uses multiple images as conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ES3D produces geometrically consistent and semantically coherent edits, enabling robust image-based and text-assisted control for 3D editing.

</details>


### [105] [Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16316)
*Ao Shen,Yongheng Zhang,Yinghui Li,Manning Wang,Di Yin,Xing Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent-OPD：在OPD的输出蒸馏之外，再对轨迹末端的隐藏表示做轨迹级潜蒸馏，并用渐进式teacher-lookahead对齐师生深层表示，从而更高效地进行视频推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LMM视频推理面临计算成本高的问题，OPD虽能匹配学生生成轨迹上的输出token分布，但仅监督输出层，难以直接约束跨多帧累积证据形成的潜在表示，因此在需要复杂证据聚合的任务中存在局限。

Method: 在On-Policy Distillation（OPD）的输出分布对齐基础上，额外对学生在轨迹末端的隐藏状态进行潜表示蒸馏，因为该位置的hidden states能汇总多帧视觉证据与推理上下文；同时采用渐进式teacher-lookahead，将学生中后层与教师更深层逐步对齐。

Result: 在6个视频推理基准上，Latent-OPD持续优于仅输出层监督的OPD；尤其在帧数受限、长视频以及需要复杂证据聚合的场景中提升更明显。

Conclusion: Latent-OPD通过在轨迹末端引入轨迹级潜表示蒸馏，并结合渐进式teacher-lookahead策略，显著提升了面向视频推理的帧高效学习效果。

Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

</details>


### [106] [Beyond Independence: Learning Correlated Views for Variational Incomplete Multi-View Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15757)
*Zheming Xu,Aiyue Tang,Shidi Chen,Xuechao Zou,Congyan Lang,Rogelio A. Mancisidor,Michael Kampffmeyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对不完整多视图聚类中的条件独立假设不足，提出一种通过可学习跨视图相关矩阵增强的变分框架，用后验误差协方差建模视图相关性，在保持参数开销很小的同时显著提升聚类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于变分推断的无插补IMVC方法虽然对缺失视图鲁棒，但通常假设各视图在后验聚合阶段条件独立，无法刻画多视图数据中真实存在的结构化、相关性关系。

Method: 提出一个变分框架，在后验聚合时利用后验估计误差的协方差结构学习视图间相关性；相关矩阵采用归一化Cholesky分解参数化，以保证正定性，并可在统一的变分目标下端到端联合训练。

Result: 在多个IMVC基准和不同缺失视图设置下，该方法持续优于SOTA，并且只引入极少的可学习参数，验证了自适应相关建模的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法通过显式建模跨视图相关性，突破了IMVC中后验聚合阶段的条件独立假设，在多个缺失视图基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Abstract: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) aims to uncover shared cluster structures from data with partially observed views. Although recent imputation-free methods based on variational inference demonstrate robustness to missing views, they commonly rely on a conditional independence assumption across views in the posterior aggregation stage, which fails to capture the inherently structured and potentially correlated nature of multi-view data. In this paper, we propose a variational framework that explicitly goes beyond this assumption by introducing a learnable cross-view correlation structure. Specifically, we explicitly model and learn correlations between views by utilizing the covariance structure of posterior estimation errors during aggregation. To facilitate robust and efficient learning, the correlation matrix is parameterized through a normalized Cholesky decomposition, ensuring positive definiteness and enabling the entire model to be trained jointly through a unified variational objective. Extensive experiments on multiple IMVC benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse missing-view settings while introducing only a negligible number of learnable parameters. These results highlight the effectiveness of adaptive correlation modeling in variational IMVC, demonstrating the need to go beyond the independence assumption in IMVC. The code is available at https://github.com/zmxu196/ACOVA.

</details>


### [107] [Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16514)
*Mohamed Amine Kerkouri,Marouane Tliba,Aladine Chetouani,Ulas Bagci,Alessandro Bruno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 三种 MLLM 在目标搜索结果上很强，但扫描路径不像人类；它们能学到‘找到了什么/在哪里’，却学不到‘按什么顺序看’，因此现有对齐与显著性指标不足以证明人类式视觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在与人类相同的凹视野输入下，是否会像人类一样进行序列化视觉搜索，从而评估其是否可作为人类视觉模型，以及现有注意力对齐指标是否真正反映人类式视觉过程。

Method: 在 COCO-Search18 目标导向搜索任务中，选取三种通用 MLLMs，逐注视点地用与人类匹配的凹视野输入驱动模型，并从三个维度评估：目标是否存在的判断、到达目标的效率、以及眼动/扫描路径过程本身。

Result: 模型在目标存在判断和目标获取上接近或超过人类，常在第一次扫视就找到目标；但其扫描路径与人类明显不同，表现为低熵、大幅度、内部一致性很强的路径，比两个人之间的一致性还高，且没有任何退化设置能在保持人类水平成功率的同时恢复人类式搜索。

Conclusion: 匹配的视网膜输入只能复现人类‘看到了哪里’，不能复现‘如何看’的时间过程。现有回答对齐和显著性指标无法证明模型具有人类式视觉；零样本 MLLMs 更适合结果与空间位置层面的任务，不适合时间/过程层面的视觉建模。

Abstract: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

</details>


### [108] [RoofGS: Roofline-Guided End-to-End Acceleration of 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15785)
*Yang Luo,Yan Gong,Yongsheng Gao,Jie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文分析了3DGS在GPU高分辨率渲染中的两个主要瓶颈，并提出RoofGS分别针对内存瓶颈和计算瓶颈做定制优化，从而在几乎不损失画质的前提下大幅提升4K实时渲染速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽然能实现实时新视角合成，但在高分辨率下GPU渲染仍受性能限制，需要区分不同阶段的硬件瓶颈并进行针对性优化，而不是一味做通用内核加速。

Method: 先用分阶段Roofline分析识别两类瓶颈：前端受全局内存流量限制，光栅化阶段受指令吞吐限制；随后针对性设计了32位分辨率自适应量化深度排序键，以及适用于裁剪后有限指数范围的位级快速指数近似，并结合内核融合、紧凑属性存储、裁剪和双像素评估等优化。

Result: 在RTX 4090上，RoofGS在4K下将吞吐从61 FPS提升到616 FPS，提升10.1×，PSNR仅下降0.028 dB。

Conclusion: RoofGS通过面向瓶颈的优化显著提升了3D Gaussian Splatting在高分辨率下的实时渲染性能，在4K分辨率下实现了10.1×端到端加速，同时几乎保持画质不变。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel-view synthesis but remains limited on GPUs at high resolutions. Through a stage-wise Roofline characterization, we identify two distinct hardware bottlenecks: global memory traffic dominates the front end, whereas instruction throughput limits rasterization. Guided by this analysis, we develop RoofGS, a rendering framework that applies bottleneck-specific optimizations rather than generic kernel acceleration. For the memory-bound front end, we design a resolution-adaptive quantized depth sorting key that compresses each key to 32 bits. For the compute-bound rasterizer, we introduce a range-aware bit-level fast exponential approximation tailored to the bounded exponent range after opacity culling, with a derived per-pixel error bound. These two core techniques are complemented by additional optimizations (kernel fusion, compact attribute storage, culling, dual-pixel evaluation) that additionally reduce memory traffic and improve instruction-level parallelism. Experiments show that RoofGS achieves a 10.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup over 3DGS at 4K on an RTX 4090, increasing throughput from 61 to 616 FPS, with only a 0.028 dB PSNR loss.

</details>


### [109] [ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15788)
*Xiaohan Zhang,Feng Gu,Xudong Rao,Xuhao Pan,Tao Wei,Zhou Pan,Kun Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ChainSpace，把空间推理从独立问答改为保持状态的多轮链式推理；同时构建了多轮基准和链式数据生成管线。结果显示，这种方法既能更准确地评估空间智能，也能用较少训练数据显著提升模型表现并具备良好迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间智能方法通常把空间推理当作彼此独立的问答样本，容易让模型依赖捷径回答，缺乏对持续空间状态的监督。

Method: 提出 ChainSpace 链式推理范式，将空间推理组织为保持状态的多轮过程；构建 ChainSpace-Bench（人工标注的真实世界多轮基准，配有 Chain-Aware Metric）和 ChainSpace-Pipeline（基于模拟器的链式监督生成框架）用于训练。

Result: 实验表明，ChainSpace-Bench 能暴露单轮准确率无法发现的链级失败；使用少量模拟器生成的链式数据训练后，模型在 ChainSpace-Bench 上取得开源模型中的最佳表现，并能较好迁移到多个外部空间智能基准。

Conclusion: ChainSpace 证明了链式、多轮、状态保持的评测与训练方式更能反映真实空间智能需求，并能以更高的数据效率提升模型性能。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process. In this paradigm, spatial questions are organized into logically constrained and jointly consistent chains, where later questions depend on spatial constraints established in earlier rounds. Following this principle, we instantiate ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric, and ChainSpace-Pipeline, a simulator-based chain-structured supervision generation framework for spatial intelligence training. Experiments show that ChainSpace-Bench exposes chain-level failures that are not captured by isolated question accuracy. Additionally, with a relatively small amount of simulator-generated chained data, models trained by ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best performance among open-source models on ChainSpace-Bench and transfer competitively to multiple external spatial intelligence benchmarks. These results establish ChainSpace as an effective paradigm for more faithful evaluation and more data-efficient learning of spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [110] [Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15796)
*Ted Lentsch,Santiago Montiel-Marín,Holger Caesar,Julian F. P. Kooij*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇工作证明：自监督点 Transformer 里已经藏着 3D 实例分割所需的结构信号，关键在 query/key 和 RoPE，而不是最终特征；作者据此提出训练免费的 TokenGraph3D，在无人工几何先验下做实例分割并优于输出特征基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向室外 LiDAR 的无监督 3D 实例分割通常依赖手工几何先验，如基于密度的聚类、运动线索或投影到 2D 后的检测结果。作者想验证：一个冻结的、自监督预训练点 Transformer 是否已经在内部表示中自发包含了分离实例所需的结构信息，而无需任何手工几何先验。

Method: 作者将冻结的自监督点 Transformer 仅作为特征提取器，在 SemanticKITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Perception 上探查其内部表示，重点比较 attention 的 queries、keys、values 和最终输出特征，以及不同编码层深度与 RoPE 的作用。基于发现，提出无需训练的 TokenGraph3D：在 key 相似图上构建连通分量来分组点，不使用基于密度的聚类或邻近性先验。

Result: 分析发现四点：1）实例信号主要集中在 attention 的 queries 和 keys 中，而不在 values 或最终输出特征中；2）输出特征会发生语义塌缩，把同类相邻物体合并，而 queries/keys 仍能区分；3）实例信号在深度上呈双峰分布，在最浅和最深编码层最强；4）该信号主要由 RoPE 驱动，移除后优势显著消失。TokenGraph3D 在相同的无先验条件下明显优于基于输出特征的基线。

Conclusion: 冻结的自监督点 Transformer 内部确实自发涌现出可用于 3D 实例分割的结构信息，且这种信息更适合从 attention 的 key/query 与 RoPE 中提取，而不是从最终输出特征中提取。TokenGraph3D 证明了无需手工几何先验也能暴露并利用这种实例结构。

Abstract: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation of outdoor LiDAR scans has traditionally relied on handcrafted geometric priors such as density-based clustering, motion cues, or projected 2D detections. In this work, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised point transformer already contains the structural information required to isolate object instances without any handcrafted geometric prior. Using this transformer purely as a feature extractor, we probe its internal representations across the SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Perception datasets. Our analysis yields four core insights: (1) the instance signal concentrates in the attention queries and keys rather than in the values or final output features; (2) output features semantically collapse, merging adjacent same-class objects that the queries and keys keep distinct; (3) this instance signal is bimodal in depth, strongest at the shallowest and deepest encoder stages; and (4) this signal is driven predominantly by the rotary position encoding (RoPE), whose removal collapses its advantage. We put these findings into our method TokenGraph3D, a training-free segmenter that groups points via connected components on a key-similarity graph, using neither density-based clustering nor proximity priors. Under identical prior-free conditions, we substantially outperform output-feature baselines, making the emergent 3D instance structure visible.

</details>


### [111] [PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15802)
*Chengyao Jia,Ruixuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PWLR把语言从“泛化语义提示”推进为“针对易混类别的局部边界证据”：先离线生成并筛选类对类验证短语，再在推理时结合全局分数和局部pairwise证据进行校准，从而显著提升近OOD和远OOD检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD检测在接近ID类边界的近OOD样本上仍然困难；现有视觉-语言方法多利用语义、局部提示或LLM生成的离群概念，但很少将语言作为区分易混ID类别的显式边界证据。

Method: 提出Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR)。离线阶段用MLLM为某个ID类相对于特定竞争类生成描述可见局部线索的短语；再用冻结的视觉-语言骨干和仅ID数据筛选这些短语，保留可靠的局部验证器。推理时先保留少量全局上最可能的类别，再检查这些类别是否能被其最相关的竞争类通过局部证据支持，最后将pairwise局部证据与全局类别分数做校准融合。

Result: 在ImageNet-100的far-OOD、cleaner/challenging OOD以及near-OOD基准上，PWLR在多个骨干模型上持续优于强视觉-语言基线。

Conclusion: PWLR通过“类对类”的局部语言证据补充全局分类分数，能更有效地区分边界附近的近OOD样本，并提升整体OOD检测性能。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.

</details>


### [112] [From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15812)
*Yiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇文章的核心结论是：对该用户的中文手写个性化任务，生成模型并不是最优解；用真实人类样本做字符级匹配和重组，反而更稳定、更接近目标风格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者在个性化中文手写的工程实践中发现，纯生成路线在“结构规范化”和“个性特征保留”之间存在根本冲突：结构压力越强，输出越像规范字；个性化越强，又可能破坏识别用户身份的关键笔画。因此需要寻找更稳妥的实现路径。

Method: 从约200张来自单一用户的真实手写图像出发，最初尝试少样本生成未见汉字，后改为基于真实人类等价类的字符匹配。系统使用CASIA多作者候选池、真实墨迹特征、字符级人群分位数、Top-20候选剪枝，以及贪心的“最难优先”整行选择，并通过跨作者组合形成虚拟书写者。

Result: 覆盖目标字符集的197个用户字符全部找到了真实人类候选，100字评测子集实现100/100覆盖；已知字符的保留测试中，有一行几乎与用户真迹不可区分。60轮稳定性审计中，每轮都落在预设的机器代理A-like区域，但这不等同于独立的人类A级判断。

Conclusion: 该工作认为，在该用户个性化中文手写场景下，真正可行的目标不是继续生成未见字符，而是利用真实人类样本进行字符级匹配与跨作者组合，构建一个接近用户风格的虚拟书写者；结果显示覆盖字符集上已有真实人类候选可用，系统可稳定达到实用B级、部分接近A级。

Abstract: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.

</details>


### [113] [FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15818)
*Genying Li,Boda Lin,Jiachen Li,Zijian Jia,Haojie Zheng,Yiming Wang,Shuchen Weng,Si Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowDance 是一个用于音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成的框架：用双流结构分别处理姿态和 RGB 生成，并用时间步感知的姿态注入与持续身份注入来保持动作和人物外观；同时构建了高质量舞蹈数据集，实验效果优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成需要同时建模音乐到动作的对应关系、保持参考人物身份、保证时间一致性，并生成视觉真实的视频，任务难度高。

Method: 提出 FlowDance 框架，将显式动作建模与参考保持的视觉合成结合起来，采用并行的姿态流和 RGB 流；设计 timestep-aware pose injection，在不同去噪步自适应调整结构引导；设计 persistent identity injection，增强长视频中的参考外观保持；同时构建一个高分辨率、实景采集的舞蹈视频数据集，包含同步音乐、RGB 视频、3D 身体运动、相机参数和投影 2D 姿态标注。

Result: 实验表明，FlowDance 在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动舞蹈视频合成两项任务上都取得了很强的性能。

Conclusion: FlowDance 通过显式动作控制、身份保持和高质量数据集，提升了音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成的效果，兼顾动作准确性、身份一致性和视频真实感。

Abstract: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations. Extensive experiments show that FlowDance achieves strong performance in both dance motion generation and music-driven dance video synthesis.

</details>


### [114] [MITE-Net: SWaP-Optimized 4K Video Tiny Target Perception for Embodied Edge SAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15830)
*Mingshuo Xu,Mu Hua,Jigen Peng,Qi Wang,Shigang Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文做了三件事：提出超轻量级MITE-Net，构建SAR-Tiny评测数据集，并在Jetson上验证其4K实时搜救能力。它在海事场景表现很强，既快又省电，但在更复杂的城市场景中仍会受限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向边缘端无人机的实时4K微小目标感知在搜救任务中至关重要，但传统降采样会丢失关键信息，切片式处理又带来过高时延，且现有方法缺少统一的4K微小目标评测与硬件基准。

Method: 提出MITE-Net，一种面向SWaP约束的级联架构：前端使用无需学习的、受生物启发的Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network（TTM-RPN）进行区域提议，后端采用参数量低于0.14M的R-CNN式检测头；同时重标注SeaDroneSee和UAVID构建SAR-Tiny Datasets，并在Jetson AGX Xavier上进行4K推理与能效评测。

Result: 在海事场景中，MITE-Net可直接处理4K图像，达到30.33 FPS和100% search success rate，仅耗电3.19 W，能效为9.51 FPS/W；相较YOLO基线，在目标召回率和能效上显著更优。但在UAVID-Tiny城市复杂场景中，前端对背景干扰敏感，超轻量检测头的表征能力不足。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一种高效的机载端到端感知范式，并提供了统一的数据集与硬件基准，为未来4K微小目标搜救检测架构提供了参考，但其在复杂城市场景下仍存在结构性瓶颈。

Abstract: Real-time tiny target perception in high-resolution imagery is critical for embodied Search-and-Rescue (SAR) missions. However, strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints on edge devices like UAVs create a bottleneck: traditional image downsampling causes severe feature loss, while slice-based processing incurs prohibitive latency. To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework encompassing a novel architecture, specialized datasets, and hardware-level benchmarks. First, we propose MITE-Net, a SWaP-optimized cascaded architecture, which couples a bio-inspired, learning-free Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network (TTM-RPN) with a sub-0.14M-parameter R-CNN-like head. Second, to standardize 4K tiny target evaluation, we construct the SAR-Tiny Datasets by relabeling two challenging UAV datasets: SeaDroneSee-Tiny (dynamic maritime scenes, tiny targets predominantly of 64-256 pixels ) and UAVID-Tiny (cluttered urban scenes, extremely tiny targets, less than 64 pixels). Third, we benchmark against state-of-the-art YOLO models on an edge device, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, where MITE-Net directly processes 4K maritime imagery, achieving a 100\% search success rate at 30.33 FPS. Consuming merely 3.19 W (9.51 FPS/W), MITE-Net vastly outperforms YOLO baselines in target recall and energy efficiency. Conversely, UAVID-Tiny evaluations expose a compound structural limitation: the learning-free bionic front-end struggles against urban backgrounds, while the ultra-lightweight head lacks representational capacity for complex features. Ultimately, this work delivers an efficient onboard perception paradigm and a rigorous baseline guiding future end-to-end SAR architectures.

</details>


### [115] [CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15831)
*Bo Zhao,Zheng Wu,Yiping Xie,Zitong YU*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出CardiacMamba，用状态空间模型融合RGB视频和RF心脏运动信息来做无接触心率估计，既提高精度，又显著减小不同肤色间的误差，并能抵抗光照、运动和模态缺失带来的退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对仅使用RGB的人脸远程光电容积描记（rPPG）方法在光照变化、运动伪影以及不同肤色反射差异下易失效的问题，提出一种同时融合RGB光学线索与射频（RF）心脏运动线索的公平且鲁棒的心率监测方法。

Method: 提出CardiacMamba框架，采用状态空间建模融合RGB-RF两模态信息；设计Temporal Difference Mamba Module（TDMM）增强RF中的细微时间变化；引入双向SSM交互机制对齐RGB与RF的异构动态；并使用Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform（CFFT）模块进行通道域频谱细化。

Result: 在EquiPleth数据集上达到0.96 bpm MAE、3.06 bpm RMSE和0.97 Pearson相关系数；同时将浅色与深色肤色之间的MAE差距降低到0.26 bpm，并在RGB退化和RF缺失条件下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CardiacMamba通过RGB-RF融合与状态空间建模，提升了rPPG心率估计的准确性、公平性和抗干扰能力，适合在复杂环境和模态受损场景下进行非接触式心率监测。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation and RF-missing conditions

</details>


### [116] [CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15905)
*Yuchen Zhang,Shuang Dai,Zeyu Fu,Yunfei Long,Ravi Shekhar,Haralambos Mouratidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARA，用 clip 级多模态建模替代传统视频级表示，并结合专家混合编码、局部-全局对比学习和 VLM 理由引导，在多个数据集上取得更好的仇恨视频检测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频平台上仇恨内容传播风险上升，但相较于文本和静态多模态内容，仇恨视频检测研究不足且更困难，因为仇恨语义往往由语音、音频和视觉等多模态信号的复杂交互产生，且这些信号通常短暂、隐式并具有时间依赖性，传统视频级表示难以捕捉。

Method: 提出 CLARA，一种 clip-level 多模态框架，将视频建模为细粒度 clip 序列而非单一实例；设计 Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder 用于自适应多模态对齐；引入 local-global segment contrastive objective 同时建模短期线索与长程时序依赖；并将 VLM 生成的 rationales 通过 gated Transformer 融合，提供高层语义引导。

Result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的实验表明，CLARA 稳定优于现有最先进方法；消融实验和参数分析验证了各组件的有效性。

Conclusion: CLARA 通过细粒度 clip 建模、对齐、对比学习和语义 rationale 融合，能更有效捕捉视频中局部且隐含的仇恨线索，并显著提升仇恨视频检测性能。

Abstract: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.

</details>


### [117] [Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15915)
*Hadi Hasan,Safaa Salman,Lama Sleem,Ralph Mouawad,Ali Chehab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文用两阶段深度学习框架分别做肺癌组织分类和病理区域分割，并比较多种主流模型；结果显示YOLO11最适合分类，DeepLabV3+最适合分割，而YOLO11-seg在接近精度下更轻量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症死亡的主要原因之一，而传统组织病理诊断容易受观察者差异和人工阅片负担影响。尽管深度学习在计算病理中表现出潜力，但同时覆盖组织分类与区域分割的系统性基准仍然不足，因此需要构建统一评测框架来提升自动化分析的准确性与效率。

Method: 第一阶段进行多类组织分类，比较自定义CNN、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义Vision Transformer和YOLO11六种模型，在由LC25000和LungHist700合并得到的39,000张图像上区分腺癌、鳞癌和正常肺组织。第二阶段进行区域分割，比较U-Net、ResNet-encoder U-Net、DeepLabV3+和YOLO11-seg，在GlaS腺体分割数据集上评估。最后将分类与分割中表现最优的模型整合为端到端框架。

Result: 在组织分类中，YOLO11表现最佳，准确率达到98.38%，五折交叉验证准确率为98.21±0.35%，宏平均F1为0.98。在区域分割中，DeepLabV3+取得最高IoU 0.80和Dice 0.89；YOLO11-seg的IoU为0.79，但参数量约少14倍。

Conclusion: 本文提出并验证了一个用于肺癌组织学图像分析的两阶段深度学习框架，将多类组织分类与像素级区域分割整合到统一流程中，并给出了各阶段的最优模型组合，作为自动化病理分析的高效、可复现基线。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. The models distinguish between adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal lung tissue. YOLO11 achieves the best classification performance, with an accuracy of 98.38%, a five-fold cross-validation accuracy of 98.21 +/- 0.35%, and a macro F1-score of 0.98. For region segmentation, U-Net, ResNet-encoder U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and YOLO11-seg are evaluated using the GlaS gland segmentation benchmark. DeepLabV3+ obtains the highest Intersection over Union of 0.80 and a Dice score of 0.89, while YOLO11-seg achieves a comparable Intersection over Union of 0.79 using approximately 14x fewer parameters. The best-performing classification and segmentation models are subsequently integrated into an end-to-end framework, providing an accurate, computationally efficient, and reproducible baseline for automated histopathological image analysis.

</details>


### [118] [BagShift: Measuring How Patch Selection Changes the Evidence Seen by Whole-Slide MIL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15970)
*Ruicheng Yuan,Zhenxuan Zhang,Liwei Hu,Anbang Wang,Haijie Xu,Jiawei Luo,Guang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 固定 patch 数不等于固定证据。BagShift 显示：MIL 部署时 selector 变化会显著影响可见证据和性能，因此评估应同时报告 selector 保留内容与多次观察的聚合方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 whole-slide MIL 通常只看到 selector 选中的 patches，但实际部署中 selector 会因算力限制、组织掩膜或区域化流程而改变；即使 patch 数不变，观察到的证据也可能不同，因此需要一个能专门评估 selector 变化影响的协议。

Method: 提出一个成对对照协议 BagShift：对同一病例改变 patch 选择器，但固定特征提取器和预测器，从而隔离 selector response 与 case mix 的影响；在 PANDA、CAMELYON16 和外部肺亚型任务上做固定 128-patch 预算的对比，并比较局部视角、全组织视角以及重复观察后的聚合策略。

Result: 在相同 128-patch 预算下，不同 selector 会显著改变模型表现：PANDA 上两种视图分别使 QWK 下降 1.57 和 17.96；CAMELYON16 上局部视图只在 10.0% 的微转移灶观察中保留肿瘤，且匹配暴露并不总能恢复性能；外部肺亚型任务响应较小但受覆盖范围差异影响，跨任务严重程度仅作描述；若有重复局部观察，先并集 patches 再做一次非线性 MIL，比平均区域预测在 PANDA 上提升 QWK 7.87。

Conclusion: 论文提出 BagShift 评估协议，用于分离选择器变化对全切片 MIL 的影响，并指出部署评估不应只看 patch 数量，而应同时报告选择器保留了什么以及多次局部观察如何聚合。

Abstract: Whole-slide multiple-instance learning (MIL) observes only the patches admitted by its selector. Deployment can alter this selector through compute limits, tissue masking, or regional workflows, even when the patch count is unchanged. We introduce BagShift, a paired protocol that changes the selector for the same case while holding its features and predictor fixed, thereby isolating selector response from case mix. With equal 128-patch budgets, sampling across the tissue or concentrating around one coordinate exposes markedly different evidence: on PANDA, the two views reduce quadratic weighted kappa by 1.57 and 17.96 points, respectively (QWK reported on the $\times100$ scale). On CAMELYON16, lesion annotations withheld from model development show that localized views retain tumor in only 10.0\% of micrometastatic observations, and matched exposure does not consistently recover the loss. The same fixed-count stressor produces a much smaller response on external lung subtyping, although differences in relative coverage make cross-task severity descriptive. When repeated localized observations are available, unioning their patches before one nonlinear MIL pass improves PANDA QWK by 7.87 points over averaging regional predictions. Patch count specifies computation, not observed evidence; deployment evaluations should report both what a selector preserves and how repeated observations are aggregated.

</details>


### [119] [CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15972)
*Yubo Zhang,Yiyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CM-MAE 用软对比对齐 + 掩码联合重建来做视觉-无线自监督预训练，在 DeepSense 6G 上显著提升跨场景迁移表现，尤其缓解了同步样本之外的伪负样本问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向跨场景的视觉-无线联合表示学习，解决单一部署中学到的表示在视角、交通、光照和传播几何变化后容易失效的问题。

Method: 提出 CM-MAE 自监督预训练框架：以同步 RGB 图像和 64-beam 接收功率向量为输入，使用基于 beam 功率相似性的 soft contrastive alignment loss 构造软正样本分布，减少相似样本被误当作负样本；同时通过 masked joint decoder 在模态 dropout 下重建被遮挡的视觉 patch 和无线角度簇；微调阶段采用 differential-rate fine-tuning，让新融合头快速适配、编码器缓慢更新。

Result: 在 DeepSense 6G 序列分离协议下，加入 soft alignment loss 后，匹配线性探针迁移平均性能从 24.88% 提升到 29.49%；轻量融合微调在未见场景 6--8 上达到 77.38% Top-1，进一步做转导式归一化自适应可达 78.69%。

Conclusion: 该方法证明了视觉-无线自监督预训练可显著提升跨场景表示迁移能力；但文中结果应被理解为表示迁移诊断，而不是主动波束预测或减少扫波的证据。

Abstract: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false negatives. A masked joint decoder provides the complementary local objective by reconstructing hidden visual patches and wireless angular clusters under modality dropout. After pretraining, a differential-rate fine-tuning rule lets a new fusion head adapt quickly while the encoders move slowly. Under a sequence-disjoint DeepSense 6G protocol, adding the soft alignment loss improves a matched linear-probe transfer average from 24.88\% to 29.49\%. Mild fusion fine-tuning reaches 77.38\% Top-1 accuracy on unseen Scenarios 6--8, and optional transductive normalization adaptation reaches 78.69\%. Since the fusion setting uses the contemporaneous 64-beam power vector at inference, these results should be read as representation-transfer diagnostics, not as proactive beam-prediction or reduced-sweeping claims.

</details>


### [120] [A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15984)
*Kaname Yokoyama,Norimichi Ukita*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的2D运动接口，让原本基于3D motion的MoLMs无需修改即可使用单目视频中的2D运动输入，并在公开数据和真实视频评测中证明其效果接近甚至优于3D运动方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoLMs依赖3D motion token，但从单目视频准确恢复3D运动很困难，导致其在真实世界中的应用受限，因此需要一种更容易从视频获取、且能直接接入MoLMs的运动表示。

Method: 提出一个即插即用的2D Motion Interface，将2D运动表示映射到3D预训练MoLMs可处理的输入形式；在公共数据集上对多个MoLMs做跨模型验证，并进一步构建单目真实视频运动评测集与real-video adapter。

Result: 在公共数据集上，该方法在多个MoLMs上达到接近3D motion输入的性能，并且优于从头使用2D motion训练MoLMs；在真实单目视频评测中，2D motion在所评估的单目姿态估计条件下也显示出比3D motion更实用的优势。

Conclusion: 2D motion可以作为MoLMs在真实单目视频场景中的实用接口，使3D预训练的MoLMs无需改模或微调即可接受2D输入，并在实际设置中更可部署。

Abstract: Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model. However, obtaining accurate 3D motions from monocular videos is challenging, limiting their real-world applicability. To address this issue, we introduce a plug-and-play 2D Motion Interface that enables 3D-pretrained MoLMs to accept 2D motion inputs without modifying or fine-tuning the original models.
  Experiments on public datasets show that our method achieves performance comparable to 3D motion inputs across multiple MoLMs and outperforms training MoLMs from scratch on 2D motions. We further construct a monocular real-world video motion evaluation dataset and introduce a real-video adapter, demonstrating the usefulness of 2D motions over 3D motions under the evaluated monocular pose-estimation setting. These results suggest that 2D motion provides a practical interface for deploying MoLMs in real-world motion understanding settings. Code is available at https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface.

</details>


### [121] [Spatial Temporal Synergy: Balancing Change and Invariance in Text Driven 3D Human Motion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16008)
*Shaohui Lin,Zhenwu Shi,Jingyu Gong,Jiao Xie,Yu Zhou,Baochang Zhang,Lizhuang Ma,Chia-Wen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CIME通过把动作编辑拆成“空间姿态变化/保持”和“时间节律变化/保持”两条主线分别建模，解决了文本编辑中既要改又要保留原动作的问题，并在两个基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的文本驱动动作编辑方法难以平衡文本响应的“变化”和对原始动作结构的“保持”，且常依赖粗糙空间约束与统一时间假设，容易造成空间姿态失真并破坏可变长度编辑中的内在运动节律。

Method: 方法上，CIME在空间姿态部分采用omni-supervised正负学习机制，结合分层回溯特征监督、细粒度动作保持和基于三元组的语义对齐；在时间节律部分引入RNIMM模块，通过具备运动学感知的非均匀时间戳来更真实地复现编辑后动作的物理节拍。

Result: 在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上的实验表明，CIME在编辑对齐性和结构保真度方面达到最先进性能，验证了其统一架构的有效性。

Conclusion: CIME提出了一个统一的文本驱动人类动作编辑框架，将“变化”和“不变性”在空间姿态与时间节律两个维度上解耦建模，从而同时提升编辑对齐性与结构保真度。

Abstract: Text-driven human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the structural consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches struggle to balance text-responsive "change" and inertial "invariance". They often rely on coarse spatial constraints and rigid uniform time assumptions, leading to spatial motion distortions and the destruction of intrinsic physical rhythms during variable-length editing. To handle these challenges, we propose Change and Invariance Motion Editing (CIME), a unified framework that comprehensively decouples change and invariance into spatial pose and temporal rhythm dimensions. For spatial poses, our method integrates an omni-supervised positive-negative learning mechanism comprising hierarchical retrospective feature supervision, subtle motion preservation, and triplet-based semantic alignment. For temporal rhythms, we introduce the Riemannian Non-uniform Integral Manifold Mapping (RNIMM) module, which achieves high-fidelity reproduction of physical beats in the edited text via kinematics-aware non-uniform timestamps.
