</details>


### [189] [VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16745)
*Yuji Wang,Teng Hu,Yuheng Chen,Ran Yi,Han Feng,Weijian Cao,Chengjie Wang,Lizhuang Ma,Jiangning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 文本指令不够精细，作者提出把图像/图对/视频对作为编辑参考的新范式，构建 40 万样本数据集并训练统一框架 VicEdit，在多项视频编辑任务上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本指令的视频编辑难以准确表达细粒度纹理和复杂动态，单一文本提示与真实编辑需求之间存在感知鸿沟。

Method: 提出 Visual In-context Editing 范式，将单图、图对、视频对等多模态视觉参考引入视频编辑；构建 VicEdit-400K 数据集，覆盖10类任务；设计 VicEdit 框架，包含用于从异构视觉参考中提取模态特定语义令牌的 Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation，以及将视觉与文本信号联合注入生成过程的 Dual-Context Injection。

Result: 在 VicEditBench 上，VicEdit 在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑任务中均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 视觉上下文学习是一种更强、可控的视频编辑新范式，能有效融合视觉与文本信息，提升编辑质量与一致性。

Abstract: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.

</details>


### [190] [Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16748)
*Hieu D. Pham,Dang P. M. Cao,Thanh Trung Huynh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇工作提出了一种不依赖真值、可后验部署的手术分割失败监测器，用多种可观测信号弥补单纯置信度监测的不足；它对未见退化有效，但误报和跨模型迁移仍是主要问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术分割网络在采集退化时可能在置信度很高的情况下错误输出掩码，现有主要依赖不确定性估计的部署监测方法会漏掉这类“自信但错误”的失效，因此需要更可靠的失败监测机制。

Method: 提出 TCSR-Monitor（Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor）这一后验失败监测框架，包装冻结的分割模型，在不依赖模型内部信息和部署期真值的情况下，融合置信度、预测形状、时序一致性与图像质量线索；同时设计验证协议评估分布偏移下告警是否可信，并使用 Mondrian conformal calibration 平衡不同退化严重度下的漏报。

Result: 在 EndoVis 2017 的 leave-one-corruption-out 评估中，TCSR-Monitor 能泛化到未见的采集退化并显著优于基于置信度的基线；圆形性控制表明其预测的是分割失败而非仅识别受损图像；Mondrian conformal 校准改善了不同退化严重度下的漏报平衡，但单一全局阈值在中度腐蚀下对最多 40% 的正确分割帧产生误报；迁移到 SAM2 时具有零样本可迁移性，但在两个阈值下都不如 entropy。

Conclusion: TCSR-Monitor 通过结合置信度、形状、时间一致性和图像质量等可观测信号，对手术分割模型在采集退化下的静默失效进行后验监测；它在 EndoVis 2017 上对未见退化具有较强泛化能力，但仍存在较高误报与跨模型迁移限制。

Abstract: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.

</details>


### [191] [Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16756)
*Tianyu Zhu,Ying Fu,Hesong Li,Gengchen Zhang,Xin Yuan,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BinRVR，一个面向RAW视频复原的二值化框架，通过BIIM和DAB-Conv同时处理时空建模与量化误差问题，在约减少96%计算和参数的情况下，仅带来约4%的性能损失，并可应用于多种复原与下游视频任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAW视频复原是高质量低层视觉感知的基础，但现有二值神经网络在视频场景中难以同时建模时序一致性和激活值分布，导致性能受限。

Method: 提出BinRVR二值化RAW视频复原框架，包含用于联合建模空间与时间信息的Binarized Information Interaction Module（BIIM），以及利用全精度激活统计信息减小量化误差的Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution（DAB-Conv）。框架还支持多比特量化，以适配不同硬件约束下的精度-效率权衡。

Result: 模型在计算量和参数量上约减少96%，性能仅下降约4%。在低光增强、去噪、去模糊和超分辨率等RAW视频复原任务上，相比现有二值方法表现具有竞争力，并可迁移到目标检测和单目深度估计等下游视频任务。

Conclusion: BinRVR证明了二值化方法可有效用于RAW视频复原，在极低开销下保持较强性能，并为不同硬件场景提供了灵活的多比特量化选择。

Abstract: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [192] [TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16765)
*Haoran Wang,Chaofan Ma,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-Bench，把多参考图像生成任务拆解为 Anchor/Disentangle/Apply/Compose 四类算子，按组合复杂度组织基准并做能力级诊断，发现当前模型最弱的是解缠与属性绑定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多参考图像生成基准仍按预定义任务类型组织，难以覆盖组合式设定，存在覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控和诊断价值低的问题；作者希望用能力导向视角重构评测框架。

Method: 将多参考任务抽象为四个原子算子：Anchor(f)、Disentangle(g)、Apply(⊕)、Compose(C)；任何提示可表示为这些算子的组合公式，并用算子槽位数量量化结构复杂度。在此基础上构建 TRACE-Bench，包含约1600个案例、631个公式模板、约4000张参考图像，并设计算子对齐的分项评分与递归故障定位的诊断树分析。

Result: 对9个领先模型的评测显示，主要瓶颈在于 disentanglement(g) 和 attribute binding(⊕)，而非场景级组合(C)；即使最佳模型的属性保真度也只有0.74。

Conclusion: TRACE-Bench 通过公式化任务结构和算子级诊断，能揭示整体分数看不出的能力短板，为多参考图像生成提供更细粒度、更可解释的评测体系。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

</details>


### [193] [Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16785)
*Gaofeng Su,Keya Li,Raja Sengupta,Kara M. Kockelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出了一个不依赖标定和道路特征的单目车辆测速框架，用车辆关键点、单应性变换和光流估计速度，在多个公开视频数据集上取得了较好的精度，适合低成本交通执法应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉测速方法往往依赖相机标定、道路特征或参考物体，部署成本高且鲁棒性不足，因此需要一种更通用、低成本、适合便携设备的测速方案。

Method: 使用36关键点车辆模板与逐帧更新的单应性矩阵，将关键点位移映射到度量空间；训练基于YOLO的关键点检测模块，并比较两种速度估计策略：仅关键点跟踪与带稠密空间聚合的扭曲光流（warped optical flow）。

Result: 在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上表现可靠；扭曲光流方法的MAE分别为15.0%和9.7%，±20%误差内的比例为77.9%和93.1%。去除边缘外点后，MAE进一步降至11.7%和7.6%，±20%准确率提升至85.3%和95.4%。

Conclusion: 提出了一种无需相机标定、无需依赖道路特征的单目视频车速估计框架，可在路侧和俯视视频中较可靠地估计车辆速度，并适用于低成本执法场景。

Abstract: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

</details>


### [194] [Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16786)
*Artem Sergievskii,Artyom Turevich,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 作者系统复核了 8 种 CFG 相关的训练免费推理增强方法，发现它们在新一代 rectified-flow transformer 上并不稳定：少数方法偶尔有提升，但总体没有可靠地超过简单、低成本的 CFG 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时质量增强方法被广泛用于无需昂贵再训练即可提升扩散模型，但许多方法最初针对旧的 U-Net 扩散模型提出，并且往往只用孤立的图像质量指标验证，缺少对文本-图像组合对齐和语义对应性的全面评估。

Method: 在固定的每模型协议下，重新评估八种源于 Classifier-Free Guidance 的训练免费推理期增强方法，使用两个开放权重 rectified-flow transformer，并在三个组合对齐基准上比较其表现。

Result: APG 在若干指标上取得名义最优，但提升多数落在评估不确定性范围内；注意力扰动类方法在 SD3.5 Medium 上偶有收益，但在 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base 上更常出现退化；整体上没有方法在所有衡量标准上稳定超过 CFG。

Conclusion: 在两个开放权重的 rectified-flow transformer 上，八种训练免费质量增强方法没有任何一种能在所测指标上稳定优于 CFG；CFG 仍然是有竞争力且成本更低的基线。

Abstract: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

</details>


### [195] [Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16791)
*Ye Lu,Shen Wang,Zhaoyang Zhang,Yihan Yan,Li Liu,Runze Liu,Fanghui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出 SFMI，把人脸模型反演攻击做成“先学人脸流形先验、再用渐进式梯度引导采样”的两阶段白盒方法，结果显示它比以往方法更稳、更准，生成的人脸也更像真实训练样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面部识别模型反演攻击主要依赖间接或高度随机的引导，导致生成轨迹难以稳定朝目标身份优化，攻击效果和可控性受限。

Method: 提出两阶段白盒模型反演方法 Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI)。第一阶段先预训练一个无条件的 Flow Matching 模型，学习人脸流形作为通用先验；第二阶段在采样过程中引入进度式引导调度器（PGS），通过对目标模型反向传播获取中间生成状态的梯度，并将时变、目标特定的引导信号逐步注入向量场，从而引导生成流从随机噪声走向目标类别高密度区域。

Result: 在 CelebA 的身份不重叠交叉评估中，SFMI 在 ArcFace 目标模型上取得 ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874；在多个目标模型上的实验表明，其在白盒协议下的攻击成功率和视觉保真度上具有竞争性的 SOTA 表现。

Conclusion: SFMI 通过将模型反演重构为轨迹引导问题，并结合通用人脸流形先验与渐进式目标梯度注入，能够更稳定地优化生成路径并显著提升面部模型反演攻击的效果与可视质量。

Abstract: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

</details>


### [196] [PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16793)
*Lingchen Sun,Rongyuan Wu,Xiangtao Kong,Jixin Zhao,Qiaosi Yi,Yujing Sun,Shuaizheng Liu,Zhengqiang Zhang,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixRestore 是一个从头训练的、无需 VAE 和 T2I 预训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer，用可靠层特征融合 + HQ 监督来做统一图像复原，最终以更少参数和单步推理达到更强效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 UIR 方法多借助大规模预训练的文本到图像潜空间扩散模型，但 VAE 可能丢失对复原敏感的细节，且开放式生成先验容易引入与内容不一致的伪影，因此需要一种更适合图像复原、能保留细节且更稳定的统一复原框架。

Method: 提出 VAE-free 的像素空间 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）用于统一图像复原，直接在 patchified pixels 上做 flow matching；通过 LQ-HQ DINO 特征相似度估计各层特征可靠性，融合更可靠层作为密集条件，对不可靠层施加强 HQ 特征监督；先在大规模多退化数据上训练，再用基于 DINO 的对抗目标微调为单步生成器。

Result: 在公共基准和真实世界测试集上，PixRestore 以单步推理、约 50M 参数取得了最佳的整体保真度、感知质量和抗多种退化能力，同时比竞品更高效；更大规模版本还能进一步提升性能，说明该像素空间设计具有良好可扩展性。

Conclusion: PixRestore 证明了无需依赖 T2I 预训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer 也能在统一图像复原中取得更强的整体表现；其 VAE-free、单步推理且参数量约 50M 的设计兼顾了复原细节、泛化性和效率。

Abstract: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

</details>


### [197] [Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16805)
*Yuanzhi Xu,Qian Gao,Jun Fan,Guohui Ding,Zhenyu Yang,Yuteng Xiao,Sixue Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文发现并量化了一个被现有评测忽视的问题：模型可能知道图里有什么，也知道属性存在，但会把属性贴到同类的错误对象上。作者为此提出 DSCAM 概念和 InstaBind-Lite 基准，使这种“错绑定”可以被直接测量，并证明常规准确率会掩盖大量此类失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉问答和幻觉评估只能判断答案是否整体正确或属性是否可由图像支持，却看不到模型是否把属性错分配给了同类中的错误实例。

Method: 形式化定义 Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding（DSCAM），构建包含524张图像、529组同类实体、1773个标注实例与9580道可确定评分问题的 InstaBind-Lite；通过源实例标注、分层问题设计和绑定专属指标，区分支持性生成、识别失败与属性转移。

Result: 在5个开源模型和2个商用/API模型上，开源模型平均错绑定率为19.84%，API模型为7.55%；其中约80%以上的可识别转移来自相邻实例。局部化和先实例后属性的干预对部分模型有效，但并非通用。

Conclusion: 提出 InstaBind-Lite 基准，用于系统测量大模型在同类密集场景中的属性错绑问题（DSCAM），揭示常规准确率和幻觉指标无法识别这类错误。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

</details>


### [198] [Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16810)
*Ziwen Liu,Martin Weigert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出一种无监督的显微图像方法：通过重建图像学习像素与稀疏潜在细胞源的对应关系，从而同时得到细胞实例分割和形态表征，无需人工标注，并在多种数据上表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显微图像分析中，细胞或细胞核等对象实例的识别与表示是基础任务，但现有流程通常依赖人工标注，并将实例分割与细胞表征分成两个独立阶段，成本高且流程割裂，因此需要一种无需标注的统一方法。

Method: 方法基于图像重建框架，使用 coarse-to-fine routing pyramid 将每个像素分配给空间稀疏的潜在源；像素到潜在源的关联用于生成实例掩码，而潜在源表示编码细胞形态信息，从而在无监督条件下联合完成实例分割与表型表征。

Result: 作者在多种细胞形态和成像模态上验证了该方法，显示出具有竞争力的实例分割效果；同时，该方法还能对扰动条件下的细胞表型进行生成式建模。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一种无需标注的细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，通过粗到细的路由金字塔同时学习像素到潜在源的关联和细胞形态表示，可在多种细胞形态与成像模态上取得有竞争力的实例分割性能，并支持对扰动下细胞表型的生成式建模。

Abstract: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

</details>


### [199] [Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16812)
*Long Cui,Xiaoqian Liu,Qi Qin,Yi Xin,Tao Lin,Jianguo Li,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文面向图像编辑提出了细粒度概念库、1200万对的ConceptEdit-12M数据集、密集监督训练策略和ConceptEdit-Bench评测集，显著提升了训练效率与模型效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑框架主要沿用文本到图像扩散模型的训练范式，但在图像编辑任务上存在两点问题：编辑概念粒度不够细，以及由于监督信号稀疏导致训练效率低。

Method: 构建了一个包含1000+细粒度编辑概念的层次化分类体系；基于改进的合成框架生成了ConceptEdit-12M数据集（1200万高质量编辑对），以缓解生成数据的分布塌缩并保证数据保真度；提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单个图像对中，以提供更丰富的学习信号；并设计了ConceptEdit-Bench用于细粒度评测。

Result: 实验表明，该策略在训练效率和整体模型性能上均显著提升，优于以往方法。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一套从细粒度概念体系、海量高质量数据构建、密集监督训练到细粒度评测的完整图像编辑方案，有效解决了概念粒度不足和监督稀疏两大瓶颈。

Abstract: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [200] [Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16855)
*Anna Mrukwa,Marek Socha,Aleksandra Suwalska,Agata Durawa,Malgorzata Jelitto,Katarzyna Dziadziuszko,Edyta Szurowska,Pawel Bozek,Michal Marczyk,Witold Rzyman,Rafal Dziadziuszko,Joanna Polanska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 RONALD 的低剂量CT支气管血管束分割流程，通过先分割肺/肺叶/纵隔，再分别分割血管和支气管，最大限度保留与结节相关的结构。实验显示其在两个数据集上都显著提高了结节保留率，适合用于增强早期肺癌筛查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌早筛中，早期结节常与血管和支气管相连，导致在低剂量CT中可见性差、误检漏检增加。作者希望通过针对支气管血管束的分析与去除，提高早期结节检测效率。

Method: 提出 RONALD 管线，用于低剂量CT中的支气管血管束分割。流程包括预处理（肺、肺叶和纵隔分割），然后分别进行血管分割和支气管树分割，最终输出肺实质内血管与支气管的二值掩膜。

Result: 在 DLCS 数据集上，结节保留率由 93.98% 和 90.36% 提升到 100%；在 Pomeranian 数据集上，由 83.16% 和 62.36% 提升到 99.92%。说明该方法相比其他分割方法能更好地保留结节。

Conclusion: 该方法生成的支气管血管束分割结果可用于降低早期肺结节的结构干扰，从而提升肺癌早期筛查中的结节检测能力。

Abstract: Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

</details>


### [201] [HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16859)
*Weiliang Chen,Haowen Sun,Jun Gao,Jiawei Chi,Hanyang Wang,Qiyu Dai,Yihao Li,Hao Li,Jingnan Gao,Yi-Hsin Hung,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Fengrui Tian,Weihua Du,Ziqi Huang,Shenyuan Gao,Siqiao Huang,Mingyu Liu,Yifei Li,Shizun Wang,Xi Wang,Tianqi Zhang,Xue Luo,Xiyin Ren,Jinshan Ren,Xiaoyang Shen,Xiaobo Hu,Zhiyang Dou,Mingyu Ding,Yichao Yan,Xinchao Wang,Yizhou Wang,Shilong Liu,Wenzhao Zheng,Yueqi Duan,Yuan Gong,Ziwei Liu,Ming-Yu Liu,Jialong Wu,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文提出 HarnessEval-W，把世界模型评测做成可解释的多代理分层推理流程：先拆题、再分工、再汇总，既能给出接近人类的判断，又能输出完整证据链，避免传统 benchmark 只有分数没有理由的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型基准多依赖暴力式指标计算，只输出标量分数，缺少可审查的推理链；但世界模型评估本质上需要判断物理、因果和世界状态是否正确，单纯分数不足以解释结果。

Method: 构建 agentified evaluation pipeline：父代理先理解评测上下文，将问题拆成多个可测子问题，再调度带有定制上下文和诊断工具的子代理分别推理，最后由父代理汇总并验证证据，形成透明的层级评估链。

Result: 在 18 个代表性世界模型、330 个评测案例上，HarnessEval-W 的判断与人类偏好高度一致，同时还能提供细粒度、可验证的 rollout 诊断。

Conclusion: 提出的 HarnessEval-W 将世界模型评测从单一分数转为可追溯的证据树式推理流程，既能给出最终判定，也能解释判定依据。

Abstract: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

</details>


### [202] [SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16863)
*Yejun Zhang,Zihan Wang,Xu Ji,Yihao Wang,Yuxin Hou,Junyuan Fang,Juho-Matti Kilpeläinen,Arno Solin,Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli,Esa Rahtu,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatGuide 复用一次 3DGS 重建输出的几何、可见性和特征三类信息，增强遮挡感知与扩散生成，显著提升无位姿新视角合成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 3D 重建 + 多视图扩散流水线通常只从重建中提取一种信号（要么渲染图像，要么学习特征），没有利用 per-Gaussian 可见性来做遮挡感知的参考选择，导致可渲染几何、可见性线索和学习特征之间存在信息断层。

Method: 先用前馈式 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）从无位姿图像重建场景；再把重建结果三路复用：1）渲染图像作为像素对齐的几何条件；2）将每个 Gaussian 的源视图索引渲染成目标视图投票图，用于遮挡感知的参考视图选择；3）将重建 token 通过 cross-attention 提供特征级指导。三种信号均来自同一次重建前向过程。

Result: 在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples 和 Mip-NeRF 360 上取得了无位姿新视角合成的 SOTA；在 RealEstate10K 上，当输入视图数量适中时，甚至超过了使用真实相机位姿的基线。

Conclusion: SplatGuide 将同一个 3DGS 重建结果同时用于几何条件、遮挡感知参考选择和特征级引导，打通了此前“信息割裂”的问题，从而实现更强的无位姿新视角合成。

Abstract: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

</details>


### [203] [An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16887)
*Dengyang Jiang,Ruoyi Du,Zhennan Chen,Dongyang Liu,Zanyi Wang,Mingzhe Zheng,Xiangpeng Yang,Huanqia Cai,Aiming Hao,Yuming Jiang,Peng Gao,Harry Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这篇论文针对像素空间扩散模型训练慢、难以超过潜空间模型的问题，提出先潜空间预训练、再切到像素空间的 latent-to-pixel 方案，并通过系统实验确定关键设计选择，最终得到更快、效果更强的像素空间生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素空间扩散模型研究多集中于小规模或类别条件设置，缺乏一套能在大规模场景下与成熟潜空间方法竞争的实用训练方案。

Method: 通过大规模实证研究，先比较像素空间与潜空间预训练的收敛速度，发现像素空间直接预训练明显更慢；据此提出 latent-to-pixel 策略，先在潜空间高效学习生成先验，再在后训练阶段切换到像素空间，并系统研究权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声日程等设计因素，归纳出可行的训练配方。

Result: 找到一套有效的训练 recipe，使像素空间模型在质量上达到或超过潜空间模型，同时实现 3.18 到 4.75 倍的端到端推理加速。

Conclusion: 该研究提出了一套实用的从潜空间迁移到像素空间的训练方案，使像素空间扩散模型在效果上可与甚至超过潜空间模型，并显著提升端到端推理速度。

Abstract: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

</details>


### [204] [NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15425)
*Yiming Fu,Fangjun Li,Xiujin Liu,Ruidong Ma,Hang Yu,Zhichen Lu,Kanwei He,Alessandro Di Nuovo,Angelo Cangelosi,Zhegong Shangguan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 作者提出了一个新的数量感知诊断基准NumerosityVLM，用来更干净地测试VLM的数感。结果表明，模型架构比视觉条件更影响表现，且数量信息主要在视觉编码器早期出现，而模型间差异更多来自语言模型部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计数基准往往把数量信息与视觉相关因素混在一起，难以真正评估VLM的数量感知能力；作者希望建立一个更接近认知科学、可控且可诊断的基准来揭示模型是否具备独立的数感。

Method: 构建了一个认知启发式诊断基准NumerosityVLM，包含10,800张合成图像，设置六种受控条件，正交操纵物体大小、空间排列和数量，并逐步消除纹理、形状和颜色等干扰因素；在零样本设置下评估7个VLM，并结合多因素分析与逐层探测。

Result: 多因素分析显示，模型架构解释了最大的性能方差（partial ω²=0.325），远高于视觉条件；逐层探测发现，数量信号在视觉编码器早期层就已可线性分离。

Conclusion: NumerosityVLM表明，当前VLM的数数/数量感知能力仍不稳定，模型架构对性能差异的解释作用最大，而可线性分离的数量信号在视觉编码器早期层即可出现；不同模型的主要差异更与语言模型部分相关。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.

</details>


### [205] [RRFC: Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning for Iterative Image-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15694)
*Kareem Hassani,Chaymaa Abbas,Hadi Al Mubasher,Mariette Awad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RRFC让图像生成器把上一轮输出再喂回去迭代修正。总体上效果混合：在重建保真和身份保持任务上更有帮助，但在语义布局任务上反而普遍变差，说明它只在反馈目标与任务目标一致时更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件图像到图像生成器通常只进行单次前向推理，输出后不再修正；作者希望让模型能够利用自身上一次预测作为反馈信号，进行迭代式自我修正，以提升输出质量。

Method: 提出 Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning（RRFC）框架：将模型最近一次预测作为额外通道反馈到下一轮输入中，与原始条件一起作为辅助条件，从而在尽量不改动核心生成器结构的前提下，修改其条件接口；并根据不同模型家族，调整训练或推理流程，使其可直接接入现有生成器。

Result: 在6种基线、3个配对图像到图像任务、18组架构-任务设置上，RRFC带来7项经Holm校正显著提升、7项下降和4项不显著变化；提升主要集中在重建保真和身份保持任务，而单一语义布局任务上全部模型均下降，且5个下降来自该任务。

Conclusion: 反馈式迭代修正并非普适增益，但当反馈目标与评估属性一致时能有效提升表现；RRFC的收益主要出现在目标与当前任务重叠的场景中。

Abstract: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. We evaluate RRFC across six baselines spanning adversarial, equilibrium, and diffusion-based models and three paired image-to-image translation tasks. Across 18 architecture-task settings, RRFC yields seven Holm-corrected improvements, seven degradations, and four non-significant changes. The gains concentrate on reconstruction-fidelity and identity settings, while five of the seven degradations fall on the single semantic-layout task, where every model declines. These results indicate that feedback-based refinement helps when its objective overlaps with the evaluated property, and that its gains concentrate on the tasks where that overlap holds.

</details>

### [206] [Auxiliary uncertainty signals for LLM-assisted systematic review screening: a benchmark across eight Cohen drug-class reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14551)
*Arya Rahgozar,Pouria Mortezaagha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 辅助BERT+GCN提供不确定性信号后，LLM筛选系统综述摘要更高效；最佳策略是只把不确定样本（MAYBE）送入LLM，并使用更丰富的上下文，但当前LLM几乎不会在二次判断中改判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已被用于系统综述的题目-摘要筛选，但其决策缺乏可校准的不确定性；作者希望用辅助模型补充结构化不确定性信息，以提高LLM筛选效率并找到最划算的提示交付方式。

Method: 在Cohen(2006)药物类别基准的8个数据集上，使用3个随机种子×5折分层交叉验证，共600个fold级结果。每折训练一个BERT+GCN分类器，将测试文献判为INCLUDE/EXCLUDE/MAYBE，并通过两种谱检验生成不确定性信号。比较5种LLM提示交付条件，变量包括信息量（无/标签/完整分数）、选择性（全部文献 vs 仅MAYBE）、时序（主动式 vs 反应式两阶段）。另在3个数据集上做了与gpt-4.1-mini的跨模型试点。

Result: 完整上下文交付带来显著提升：F1 +0.011、WSS@95 +0.050，且召回率保持不变，但token成本增加1.28倍。仅对MAYBE样本路由是帕累托最优：平均召回0.92、AUC-ROC 0.54，成本仅为基线的1.05倍。两阶段设计升级了22.2%±8.8%的记录，但从未改变决定，翻转率为0%，说明当前LLM不能自我triage。跨模型试点显示两代LLM都获得相同的+0.8%召回提升。

Conclusion: LLM用于系统综述题目-摘要筛选时，若结合辅助BERT+GCN模型提供的结构化不确定性信号，并采用“MAYBE-only”路由和合适的提示交付策略，可以在较小额外成本下提升筛选效率与效果；同时当前指令微调LLM无法可靠自我复核初筛决策。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for title-abstract screening in systematic reviews, but their decisions lack calibrated uncertainty. We show that an auxiliary BERT+GCN classifier supplies a structured uncertainty signal that improves LLM screening efficiency, and we identify the prompt-delivery strategy that maximises the benefit-to-cost ratio.
  We evaluate five LLM prompt-delivery conditions on eight drug-class datasets from the Cohen (2006) benchmark using 3 seeds x 5-fold stratified cross-validation (600 fold-level results). A BERT+GCN model trained per fold classifies each test paper as INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, or MAYBE via two spectral tests (algebraic radical and categorical paradox). Conditions vary information content (none / label / full scores), selectivity (all papers vs. MAYBE only), and timing (proactive vs. reactive two-pass). A cross-model pilot against gpt-4.1-mini on three datasets tests cross-generation transfer.
  Three findings: (i) Full-context delivery yields significant gains in F1 (+0.011, paired Wilcoxon p=0.008) and WSS@95 (+0.050, p=0.039) at a 1.28x token-cost premium, while preserving recall. (ii) MAYBE-only routing is Pareto-optimal: highest mean recall (0.92) and AUC-ROC (0.54) at only 1.05x baseline cost -- one sixth of full-context overhead. (iii) The two-pass design escalates 22.2% +/- 8.8% of records yet never revises its decision (0% flip rate across all datasets and folds), giving decisive evidence that current instruction-tuned LLMs cannot self-triage. The cross-model pilot shows an identical +0.8% recall uplift for both LLM generations. A per-paper ablation across 20,796 observations shows the dual paradox test reduces empirically to a one-line logit-gap criterion. We release the full pipeline; the 600-run experiment replays in under one hour from cached LLM responses.

</details>


### [207] [HarmProfile: Characterizing Harmful Distributions in Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14577)
*Zhouyuan Ma,Yutao Wu,Hanxun Huang,Xiang Zheng,Xiao Liu,Yixin Cao,Zuxuan Wu,Xingjun Ma,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HarmProfile 用大规模失效样本把 LLM 的“有害输出分布”当作风险画像来研究，发现更强的模型往往既更有害也更丰富，安全表象之下仍存在更深层风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 frontier LLM 安全评估多把有害生成视为攻击结果，而非模型失效本身的分析对象；缺少大规模、高质量的前沿模型失效输出数据，导致难以刻画模型级风险。

Method: 提出 HarmProfile 内容中心基准数据集，收集 23 个 frontier LLM、13 个模型家族在 15 个危害类别和 57 个子类别上的失效样本，并验证整理出超过 80,000 个有害输出工件；将有害输出的内容、严重性和多样性定义为模型级风险画像。

Result: 构建了大规模验证语料库；实验发现 frontier LLM 能稳定、大规模地产生有害内容，且不同模型具有不同风险画像；模型能力越强，有害性与多样性越高。

Conclusion: frontier LLM 可能表面上更安全，但其对齐表层下仍可能隐藏更危险的知识与更复杂的失效模式；应从输出内容分布而非单次攻击成功与否来评估模型风险。

Abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) safety evaluation has largely treated harmful generation as an attack outcome rather than as an object of analysis. Consequently, little is known about the harmful outputs produced during model misbehavior, partly because large-scale, high-quality collections of frontier-LLM misbehavior are difficult to obtain. To address this gap, we introduce HarmProfile, a content-centric benchmark dataset that collects model misbehavior across diverse harm categories and model families, and defines the resulting harmful-output distribution as a model-level risk profile. The premise is that, just as linguistic behavior can be characterized from an utterance corpus, model risk can be characterized from the content, severity, and variation of its safety failures. HarmProfile contains over 80,000 validated artifacts from 23 frontier LLMs across 13 model families, organized into 15 harm categories and 57 subcategories. Using this corpus, we find that frontier LLMs reliably produce harmful content at scale, yet exhibit distinct risk profiles; both harmfulness and diversity grow with model capability, suggesting that frontier LLMs may appear safe yet harbor increasingly dangerous knowledge beneath the alignment surface. Our source code is available at https://github.com/fresh-ma/HarmProfile .

</details>


### [208] [Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System: Fuzzy Inference Guided Large Model Interactive Question Answering Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14584)
*Hailong Yang,Jianqi Wang,Guanjin Wang,Zhaohong Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇工作提出了一个结合模糊系统与多模态生成推理的框架 MMGFS，通过协同沉思、模糊规则和多跳推理来提升多模态问答的鲁棒性与推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态问答需要联合编码文本、图像和语音等异构信息，但现有深度学习模型和大模型/提示式方法仍面临三类关键问题：模态偏置、跨领域知识带来的不确定性，以及浅层语义匹配导致的推理深度不足和可解释性弱。

Method: 受传统模糊系统启发，构建了一个模糊推理指导的多模态生成框架 MMGFS。其核心包括多模态协同沉思机制，用于减轻不同模态特征分布差异带来的偏置；以及引入模糊规则和多跳推理机制，实现跨领域知识融合与层次化推理。

Result: 在 MultimodalQA、WebQA、BioMol-VQA 和 EHRxQA 等数据集上的实验表明，MMGFS 在多个指标上持续优于现有方法，尤其在答案准确率、一致性和泛化能力方面表现更强。

Conclusion: 提出的多模态生成模糊系统 MMGFS 能有效缓解多模态问答中的模态偏置与问题不确定性，并在多个开放域和领域特定数据集上取得更好的准确率、一致性和泛化性能。

Abstract: In Multimodal Question Answering (MQA), models are required to jointly encode and integrate heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including text, images, and speech, to perform complex semantic reasoning and decision making. Despite recent advances, existing approaches, including traditional deep learning models and Large Models (LMs) or prompt-based frameworks, continue to face several critical challenges. First, modality bias arises from discrepancies in feature distributions across different modalities, which limits effective cross modal collaborative understanding. Second, many questions require knowledge drawn from multiple domains, introducing significant uncertainty. Third, current methods often rely on shallow semantic matching, resulting in limited reasoning depth an reduced interpretability. To address these issues, inspired by the traditional fuzzy system (FS) framework, we propose a fuzzy-inference-guided multimodal generative architecture termed the Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System (MMGFS). The main contributions of MMGFS are two folds. First, it alleviates modality bias through a multimodal collaborative rumination mechanism. Second, it introduces fuzzy rules and a multi-hop inference mechanism to support cross-domain knowledge fusion and hierarchical reasoning, thereby strengthening uncertainty modelling and deepening semantic understanding. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on open-domain question answering datasets, including MultimodalQA and WebQA, as well as domain-specific benchmarks, including BioMol-VQA and EHRxQA. Experimental results demonstrate that MMGFS consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. It effectively mitigates modality bias and question uncertainty while achieving superior performance in answer accuracy, consistency, and generalization.

</details>


### [209] [Wiola 13M, a Gated Spiral Attention Architecture for Parameter Efficient Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14604)
*Aryuemaan Kumar Chowdhury,Praveen Oosa,Vineesha Reddy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Wiola 是一个面向小参数语言模型的解码器架构，核心是三处层内改造：更适合长程信息的旋转位置编码、内容自适应门控注意力、以及改善梯度流的蝴蝶式前馈块；它还保证训练与推理在注意力缓存下严格一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向仅有千万到上亿参数的小型语言模型，现有方法大多直接沿用标准 Transformer 块，缺少对小规模、低算力与长程建模需求的专门适配。

Method: 提出 Wiola，一个仅解码器语言模型，在每层中替换为三种即插即用组件：1) Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding 通过按维度缓慢增长的因子扰动旋转频率；2) Gated Spiral Attention 用由查询流因果累积统计得到的内容自适应标量门控实现软头选择；3) Butterfly feed forward block 用乘性交互和块内旁路替代常规扩张层。作者还对参数量与计算量进行严格推导，并证明门控注意力在全序列训练与缓存自回归解码之间精确等价。

Result: 该模型在不增加推理近似的前提下，实现了更强的长程区分能力、软头选择能力和更好的梯度流，并提供了可复现实验流程、标准小型故事语料训练与评测，以及开源实现和可发布权重支持。

Conclusion: Wiola 通过针对小模型场景设计的三项低成本结构改造，在保持参数和计算预算可控的同时增强了小型语言模型的建模能力，尤其适合端侧推理、快速实验和受控科学研究。

Abstract: Small language models in the ten to one hundred million parameter range are attractive for on device inference, rapid experimentation, and controlled scientific study, yet most of them reuse the standard transformer block without adaptation to the small scale regime. We present Wiola, a decoder only language model whose novelty is concentrated in three drop in components of every layer. First, Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding perturbs the standard rotary frequencies by a slowly growing per dimension factor so that phase trajectories fan outward, improving long range discrimination while adding no parameters. Second, Gated Spiral Attention introduces a per head, content adaptive scalar gate derived from a causal cumulative statistic of the query stream, providing an implicit and differentiable form of soft head selection at negligible cost. Third, the Butterfly feed forward block replaces the conventional expansion layer with a multiplicative interaction and an intra block bypass path, matching the parameter count of a four times gated linear unit block while improving gradient flow in shallow stacks. We formalize each component, derive exact parameter and computation budgets, and prove that the gated attention admits an exact and numerically verified equivalence between full sequence training and cached autoregressive decoding, so that no approximation is introduced at inference time. We also describe a fully reproducible training and evaluation protocol on a standard tiny story corpus. The reference implementation is released as an open source package with weights ready publishing support.

</details>


### [210] [AutoMem: A Text-Gradient Recursive Self-Improvement Framework for Automated Memory Architectures Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14621)
*Lin Du,Jie Zhou,Yuxuan Cai,Kai Chen,Qin Chen,Xin Li,Bo Zhang,Wei Li,Liang He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文发现LLM智能体的记忆模块没有通用最优组合，于是提出AutoMem，用经验和失败反馈来自动搜索最适合任务的记忆架构，最终在多个基准上提升准确率并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的长期记忆设计高度耦合，编码、存储、检索与管理方式会随任务和基础模型变化而显著不同，因此不存在通用最优的记忆架构，需要自动化、任务自适应的搜索方法。

Method: 构建包含5种编码器、5种存储器、6种检索器和4种管理器的离散搜索空间；提出文本梯度递归自我改进框架AutoMem，由经验引导的架构搜索和失败引导的模块诊断两部分组成，利用历史轨迹、反思与针对性文本反馈进行迭代搜索。

Result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DeepSearch上，AutoMem在两种LLM骨干上都找到更优的任务自适应记忆架构，较最强人工基线平均提升2.8个百分点；在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B下还将token成本降低14.3%，并在少量引导迭代内优于更大规模的随机搜索。

Conclusion: AutoMem通过任务自适应的记忆架构搜索，能够稳定找到优于人工设计基线的模块组合，并在准确率和效率上取得更优折中。

Abstract: Long-term memory is increasingly central to LLM agents, yet memory design remains a highly coupled architecture problem: what to encode, how to store it, how to retrieve it, and how to manage it can vary substantially across tasks and backbone models. We construct a discrete search space with 5 encoders, 5 stores, 6 retrievers, and 4 managers, and show that no single memory architecture consistently dominates: different tasks favor different module combinations, leading to substantial performance gaps. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{AutoMem}, a text-gradient recursive self-improvement framework for task-adaptive memory architecture search. \textsc{AutoMem} optimizes over the factored space through two components: Experience-Guided Architecture Search, which proposes candidate architectures from historical search trajectories and accumulated reflections, and Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis, which localizes memory-related failures to specific modules and converts them into targeted textual feedback. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DeepSearch across two LLM backbones show that \textsc{AutoMem} consistently discovers task-adaptive memory architectures that outperform the strongest human-designed memory baselines, improving accuracy by $2.8$ points on average across six benchmark-backbone settings. Further analysis shows that \textsc{AutoMem} achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, reducing token cost by $14.3\%$ over the strongest accuracy baselines under Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, while also finding stronger architectures than substantially larger random searches within only a few guided iterations.

</details>


### [211] [LLM Safety Alignment in Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14626)
*Valdini Douglace Lemofouet,Blessing Ngozi Uzor,Paula Chikaodinaka Anyanwu,Danielle Blanche Kapsa,Sukairaj Hafiz Imam,P Sam Sahil,Abigail Oppong,Tassallah Abdullahi,Clemencia Siro,Idris Abdulmumin,Seid Muhie Yimam,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文系统综述了低资源语言中的LLM安全对齐研究，指出多语言安全评测与对齐明显不足，翻译基准不够、攻击更容易、低资源语言缺少基准，呼吁构建更文化敏感且可扩展的多语言安全对齐体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐在低资源语言和多语言场景中的保障明显弱于高资源语言，且相关研究分散，缺乏系统性梳理与统一分类。

Method: 采用PRISMA 2020方法进行系统性文献综述（SLR），从Semantic Scholar、arXiv和OpenAlex检索约1500篇论文，筛选出50篇相关研究，围绕安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评测基准和跨语言迁移四个主题进行分析，并提出基于数据适配、目标优化和机理对齐三类适配机制的安全对齐方法分类法。

Result: 综述发现：翻译的英文基准不足以覆盖文化根植性危害；多语言模型更易受到跨语言越狱、代码切换攻击和低资源语言安全退化影响；主要原因包括多语预训练覆盖不均、母语偏好数据不足、安全表示迁移不佳以及缺乏文化感知评测框架；尤其是非洲语言等低资源语言的安全基准明显不足。

Conclusion: 多语言安全存在持续且显著的差距，未来需要文化本地化基准、参与式数据收集、均衡的多语预训练，以及可扩展的多语言对齐方法来缩小这一鸿沟。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in safety alignment, yet their safety guarantees remain significantly weaker in low-resource and multilingual settings than in high-resource languages. In this paper, we conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of LLM safety alignment in low-resource languages by adopting the PRISMA 2020 methodology. Out of roughly 1,500 papers identified from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex, 50 relevant studies have been selected and analyzed. Our review is organized around four themes: safety alignment methods, multilingual safety risks, evaluation benchmarks, and cross-lingual transferability. We further propose a taxonomy of safety alignment approaches based on three adaptation mechanisms: data adaptation, objective optimization, and mechanistic alignment. Across literature, translated English benchmarks fail to sufficiently represent culturally rooted harms, and multilingual models are more vulnerable to cross-lingual jailbreaks, code-switching attacks, and safety degradation in underrepresented languages. These failures are driven by several key factors, including uneven multilingual pre-training coverage, insufficient native-language preference data, poor transfer of safety representations, and a lack of culturally aware evaluation frameworks. The review also notes that many low-resource languages, especially African languages, have fewer safety benchmarks available than other multilingual regions. Overall, the results reveal a persistent multilingual safety gap, and suggest that future progress will require culturally grounded benchmarks, participatory data collection, balanced multilingual pre-training, and scalable multilingual alignment methods.

</details>


### [212] [Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14629)
*Tejaswi V. Panchagnula,Bruce Coburn,Bryce J. Dietrich,Robert X. Browning,Edward J. Delp,Fengqing Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究如何防止 LLM 在政治摘要任务中被提示注入偏见；通过 CoT、DPO 和递归自我纠错等方法，发现 Recursive Self-Correction 最能提升政治中立性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在信息检索和摘要任务中被广泛使用，但现有对齐方法主要关注通用安全性，未专门针对政治偏见；同时，模型容易受到对抗性提示注入影响，从而生成带偏见的摘要。

Method: 基于公开的立法视频数据集，使用LLM生成摘要，并通过对抗性提示注入政治偏见；在四轴政治摘要评估框架下比较不同缓解策略，重点方法包括 Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting、Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)，以及 Recursive Self-Correction。

Result: 实验表明，Recursive Self-Correction 能显著提升政治中立性表现，Political Neutrality Likert 评分从基线 2.14 提升到 4.56，且该结果是在所有模型平均意义下得到的。

Conclusion: 该研究说明，推理阶段的自我纠错机制可以有效缓解 LLM 摘要中的政治偏见，优于简单依赖现有对齐范式的做法。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.

</details>


### [213] [Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14630)
*Zirui Cheng,Joey Chan,Simo Du,Chenhao Tan,Yue Guo,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文关注的不是 LLM 是否答对，而是它“怎么说”会不会害人。作者提出“修辞失配”概念，并在临床决策实验中发现，LLM 的表达方式会让一部分原本正确的判断变错，说明高风险场景里仅有事实正确还不够，表达方式本身也必须被纳入安全评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 被用于高风险的人机决策，研究者希望弄清其输出是否会放大人类认知偏差、如何影响人类判断，以及这种影响是否会带来实际危害。

Method: 作者提出了一个决策理论框架来刻画“修辞失配”（rhetorical misalignment），并通过基于美国医学执照考试数据的临床决策人类受试实验进行实证检验；同时，为了可扩展评估，还用 LLM 充当被模拟的决策者来计算和衡量这种失配。

Result: 实验显示，不同模型平均会导致 2.81% 的有害决策翻转，即临床参与者从正确答案改为错误答案；受试者的理由表明，这些改变与 LLM 的语言风格有关，并可能触发锚定效应、权威偏差和损失厌恶等认知偏差。

Conclusion: 该研究得出结论：LLM 即使在事实内容上与任务对齐，也可能因不恰当的修辞呈现方式诱发人类做出有害决策，因此高风险场景中的安全评估不能只看事实正确性，还要考虑表达方式对决策的影响。

Abstract: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

</details>


### [214] [DeMTS: Denoising Trajectories as Multivariate Time Series for Hallucination Detection in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14632)
*Xin Zhang,Yili Wang,Yue Tan,Xin He,Yanyu Qian,Yixin Liu,Yi Chang,Shirui Pan,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文针对 D-LLM 幻觉检测中“只看单一维度、忽略完整去噪轨迹结构”的问题，提出 DeMTS，把去噪轨迹转成多变量时序来建模，实验表明它比现有方法更准且更稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散式大语言模型的幻觉检测方法通常只沿时间维或 token 维压缩去噪轨迹，忽略了完整二维 token-step 结构中包含的不确定性演化与跨 token 传播信息，因此难以捕捉不一致收敛和错误传播等幻觉相关模式。

Method: 提出 DeMTS（Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series）。首先通过轨迹保持的 token-to-variable 分配模块，将 token 级信号映射到稳定的潜变量；然后基于这些变量进行动态多变量时序建模，逐步融合变量间依赖关系与时间编码，用于幻觉预测。

Result: 在两个 D-LLM backbone 和三个基准上，DeMTS 相比现有幻觉检测方法取得更优表现，同时保持较强的鲁棒性、效率和跨任务迁移能力。

Conclusion: 将去噪轨迹建模为多变量时序能够更充分利用二维 token-step 信息，提升扩散式大语言模型的幻觉检测效果。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for text generation. However, similar to autoregressive LLMs, D-LLMs remain vulnerable to hallucinations, where fluent outputs may contain factually incorrect or unsupported content. Although existing hallucination detection methods for D-LLMs attempt to leverage uncertainty trajectories of the denoising process to better identify hallucination signals, they typically compress the trajectories along either the temporal or token dimension, overlooking the useful information encoded in the complete two-dimensional token-step structure. Consequently, they may fail to capture hallucination-relevant patterns, such as inconsistent convergence and cross-token fault propagation, leading to suboptimal detection performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a D-LLM hallucination detection framework that formulates the Denoising trajectories as Multivariate Time Series over learnable latent variables (DeMTS for short). DeMTS employs a trajectory-preserving token-to-variable assignment module to convert token signals into stable latent variables. Based on these variables, we propose dynamic multivariate temporal modeling to progressively integrate inter-variable dependency modeling with temporal encoding for hallucination prediction. Extensive experiments on two D-LLMs backbones and three benchmarks demonstrate that DeMTS outperforms existing hallucination detection methods while maintaining strong robustness, efficiency, and cross-task transferability.

</details>


### [215] [Automatic or Controlled? Repetition Priming Reveals Divergent Processing in Base LLMs, Instruct LLMs, and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14681)
*Jinglei Ren,Yuyue Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这项研究用重复启动实验发现：基础模型和指令模型对重复信息的处理机制明显不同，后训练会让模型从“自动激活”转向更“受控”的重复加工，而人类表现介于两者之间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复词在自然语言中极常见，但语言模型究竟是重新激活先前表征，还是对重复词进行重新评估，以及后训练是否改变这一默认机制，仍不清楚。

Method: 在15个覆盖5个模型家族、参数规模1.5B到14B的模型上，使用重复启动范式（repetition priming），设计语义分类和完形填空两项任务，并与使用相同刺激的人类实验对照，考察不同重复间隔、上下文移除以及注意前次出现的效应。

Result: 基础模型表现出自动加工特征：重复带来即时促进、跨间隔较稳定、去除上下文后仍部分保留，并且与对先前出现的注意相关；指令模型表现出受控加工特征：促进效应随间隔衰减、缺少预期上下文时消失，并在更大尺度上转为干扰。Qwen 2.5系列中，这种分化随模型规模单调增强；人类则呈现混合模式，像指令模型那样对间隔敏感，但不出现干扰。

Conclusion: 后训练（尤其指令微调）会显著改变语言模型对重复词的处理方式：基础模型更像自动激活旧表征，而指令模型更像受控重评估；这种差异随模型规模增大而更明显。

Abstract: Words recur constantly in natural language use, yet it remains unclear whether language models reactivate prior representations or re-evaluate repeated words afresh, and whether post-training changes this default behavior. We apply repetition priming (Shiffrin and Schneider, 1977) to 15 models across five model families (1.5B-14B parameters) in two tasks, semantic categorization and cloze completion, with matched human experiments using identical stimuli. We find that base models exhibit automatic processing: they show immediate facilitation that remains stable across lags, partially survives context removal, and correlates with attention to prior occurrences. Instruct models exhibit controlled processing: their facilitation decays with lag, collapses without expected context, and reverses to interference at larger scales. Within the Qwen 2.5 family, this dissociation increases monotonically with model scale, suggesting that post-training progressively alters repetition processing. Humans show a hybrid profile, with lag-sensitive facilitation resembling instruct models but without interference, suggesting that neither model type fully captures human cognition. Our findings reveal a qualitative shift in how language models process repeated information after post-training and provide mechanistic evidence for the divergence between model behaviors.

</details>


### [216] [Domain Agnostic Text Redaction from Natural Language Rules using Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14693)
*Aravindhan Arunagiri,Ayaan Khan,Udayaadithya Avadhanam,SaiBarath Sundar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种面向任意敏感定义的可解释文本脱敏方法：用大模型生成规则、再微调小模型按规则逐步识别并删除敏感内容，并输出自然语言解释与触发规则；结果显示脱敏精度高、重构难度大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本脱敏主要面向结构化敏感信息（如PII），对非结构化内容支持不足，且通常缺乏可解释的删除依据，难以满足审计、合规和人工复核需求。因此需要一种既通用又可解释的文本脱敏方案。

Method: 先由通用大语言模型根据用户对敏感信息的自然语言定义生成或扩展脱敏规则，再用这些规则对一个较小的语言模型进行指令微调；该模型在处理文档时逐步推理规则，识别并删除对应敏感内容，同时输出透明解释与触发该删除的具体规则。另使用基于重构的指标评估从脱敏文档中恢复原文信息的难度，以量化脱敏覆盖度。

Result: 实验表明该方案具有较高的重构误差和较高的脱敏精度，说明其在隐藏敏感信息的同时保留了较好的覆盖能力，适用于法律取证、医疗文档和企业信息治理等关键应用。

Conclusion: 该方法将自然语言形式的“脱敏规则”与指令微调语言模型结合，能够对非结构化文档中的敏感信息进行可解释红action，并为每次删除提供自然语言理由与触发规则，适合需要审计与合规的场景。

Abstract: With the increasing digitization of personal and corporate communication, the automatic sanitization of textual data has become a crucial component of data privacy and compliance frameworks. Traditional text sanitization solutions are majorly suitable for obscuring sensitive data with standard structure such as Personal Identifiable Information (PII). These solutions do not provide transparent justification for their redaction, which makes it difficult to audit them. This paper introduces an explainable, domain-agnostic text redaction solution that uses natural language rules of redaction, applied via an instruction-tuned language model, to identify and redact sensitive information in unstructured documents. Unlike traditional text sanitization, this method enables a user to conveniently define any sensitive information; which may be structured (e.g.\ PII) or unstructured (e.g.\ legal terms and conditions) in natural language. A general-purpose LLM generates or augments these natural language rules of redaction from the user's definition, which are then used to instruction-fine-tune a smaller language model that reasons the rules step-by-step over any given document to identify and redact the corresponding sensitive content, while providing transparent justifications for each redaction and highlighting the specific rule that triggered the decision. This explanation is generated in natural language to support human reviewers and auditors in understanding why specific content was redacted. A reconstruction-based metric is used to estimate the probability of recovering redacted information from the sanitized document, quantifying redaction coverage. The solution shows high reconstruction error and high redaction precision, making it suitable for automated text sanitization in critical applications such as legal discovery, medical documentation, and corporate information governance.

</details>


### [217] [Which Question Is Your Attention Metric Answering? Attention Rows as Compositional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14712)
*Marios Papamichalis,Regina Ruane*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文指出：比较 attention 时“保不保留 sink token”不是小细节，而是会改写结论。作者证明把 attention 视为 compositional data 后，可以严格分解 sink 和 content 两部分，从而更可靠地分析相似度、熵变化、聚类和剪枝效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer attention 行通常把大部分概率集中到一个 sink token 上，而现有用于比较 attention 行的指标往往没有明确说明是否保留 sink；这一选择会显著改变比较结论，导致对 head 相似性、聚类结构、熵变化和剪枝效果的解释不稳定。

Method: 作者在 10 个来自 5 个家族的预训练模型上比较了保留 sink 与移除 sink 并重归一化两种 convention 下的 cosine similarity、Jensen–Shannon divergence、Shannon entropy 等指标，统计结论翻转比例；随后把 attention 行建模为 compositional data，证明 Aitchison distance 可正交分解为 sink 项与 content 项，熵也有精确分解，并检验该 content 距离与 transformer 所具备不变性的一致性；还分析训练过程中的熵下降来源，并测试了一个冻结的 out-of-sample 预测器。

Result: 在 10 个模型上，17%–47% 的“哪个 head 更相似”的判断会因 convention 改变而翻转；标准 BERT head 聚类流程中的主要结构可能是该 convention 的伪影；训练中的熵下降主要来自 sink 增长而非内容注意力更尖锐（不同规模下占比从 30% 到 95% 不等）；用错误通道做 head 剪枝会使 perplexity 增加超过 100 倍；对安全区域的映射和冻结预测器的测试分别得到一次确认、一次拒绝、一次失败。

Conclusion: 将 attention 行视为 compositional data 后，能够把“sink token 占比”和“content tokens 的分配方式”严格分离，从而避免传统相似度/熵指标因是否保留 sink 而得出相反结论；这一区分在实践中对聚类、训练动态解释和剪枝评估都很关键。

Abstract: Each row of a transformer's attention matrix is a probability distribution over tokens, and in trained models most of that probability lands on a single \emph{sink} token, usually the first. Standard tools for comparing attention rows (cosine similarity, Jensen--Shannon divergence, Shannon entropy) therefore hinge on a choice papers rarely report: keep the sink, or drop it and renormalize. This choice can reverse conclusions. On ten pretrained models from five families, 17--47% of verdicts about which of two heads is more similar flip with the convention, and the most prominent structure in a standard BERT head-clustering pipeline is an artifact of it. The reason is that one-number summaries mix two questions: how much attention the sink takes, and how the rest is divided among the content tokens. Treating rows as compositional data separates them exactly: the Aitchison distance splits orthogonally into a sink term and a content term, entropy splits by an exact identity, and the content distance is characterized by invariances the transformer itself possesses. The separation matters in practice: most measured entropy collapse during training is the sink growing, not attention sharpening (30% of the drop at 70M parameters, 95% at 1B, 79% at 1.4B), and pruning heads with the wrong channel can inflate perplexity more than a hundredfold. We map where each convention is safe, test a frozen out-of-sample predictor (one confirmation, one abstention, one failure), and release code regenerating every number.

</details>


### [218] [Class Imbalance and Batch Effects in LLM-Based Screening for Systematic Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14737)
*Gilberto Sussumu Hida,Danilo Monteiro Ribeiro,Clayton Suguio Hida*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇研究发现：给LLM提供类别普遍率信息基本没用，但把样本按批次一起处理会明显改变决策，而且这种影响取决于类别比例；因此批量处理不应只看省钱，还要看它会不会改变判断方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估LLM在不平衡二分类中的表现，尤其是研究筛选这类实际场景中，逐条/批量处理方式以及类别先验信息是否会影响模型决策。

Method: 以系统综述中的研究筛选为应用场景，在5篇综述上进行实验；比较了逐条处理与批量处理，并设置是否提供类别普遍率（prevalence）元数据的条件，同时做了总体与条目级分析。

Result: 普遍率元数据影响有限，未观察到其能提升性能；批量处理带来了更大的行为变化，而且这种变化会随类别普遍率不同而变化；总体分析与条目级分析并不总是一致。

Conclusion: 在不平衡二分类任务中，批量处理会显著改变LLM的决策行为，而普遍率元数据对性能提升没有证据支持；因此，批量处理不能只按成本评估，还应关注其对判定行为的影响。

Abstract: This study analyses LLMs in imbalanced binary classification, using study screening in systematic reviews as the application domain. An experiment was conducted in five reviews, comparing individual and batch processing, with and without prevalence metadata. The results indicate a limited influence of the prevalence metadata, with no evidence that it improves performance. In contrast, batch processing produced larger behavioral changes that varied according to the prevalence of the class. The aggregate and item-level analyses did not always coincide. Therefore, batch processing should be evaluated not only in terms of cost, but also in relation to its effects on decision-making behavior.

</details>


### [219] [Prompting is not enough: supervised baselines and leakage control for measuring shared decision-making with LLMs in pediatric encounters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14792)
*Bernardo Modenesi,Jody Lin,Kimberly Kaphingst,Angela Zhu,Maya Wheeler,Peilu Zhang,Angela Fagerlin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在这项SDM识别任务中，零样本LLM表现较弱，简单监督模型更好；评估是否可信高度依赖数据切分粒度和标签示例进入流程的位置，外部验证必不可少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验大型语言模型的零样本提示是否足以检测真实临床对话中的SDM行为，以及在严格的患者分组、嵌套评估框架下，监督学习是否还能带来额外收益。

Method: 基于21段门诊外科决策音频记录、7566个话语片段，对12类共享决策（SDM）行为进行人工标注；在患者分组的外层交叉验证下，比较零样本本地LLM（Qwen 2.5 32B）、基于冻结句向量的监督分类器及两者的逻辑回归堆叠，并使用内层交叉拟合阈值和患者重采样置信区间评估。

Result: 零样本LLM的宏平均kappa为0.139；监督分类器提升到0.227，显著优于零样本；两者堆叠进一步到0.242。研究还发现多条特定于语料的泄漏路径，包括兄弟姐妹录音分组不当，以及外层留出患者的标签被用于少样本示例。

Conclusion: 零样本提示不足以像小型监督模型那样可靠测量SDM行为；仅做患者层分组也不能完全避免泄漏，若带标签的提示示例在外层评估循环之外预先生成，结果会受影响。

Abstract: Objectives: To determine whether zero-shot prompting of a large language model (LLM) is sufficient to detect shared decision-making (SDM) behaviors in real clinical encounters, and whether supervised learning adds value under patient-grouped, nested evaluation.
  Methods: We analyzed 21 audio-recorded outpatient surgical decision encounters (19 unique patients; 7,566 utterance segments; ~6.1 hours) between families of children with multiple long-term conditions and their surgical providers. Trained coders labeled segments for 12 SDM behaviors (human-human macro Cohen's kappa = 0.695). We compared a zero-shot local LLM (Qwen 2.5 32B), a supervised classifier over frozen sentence embeddings, and their logistic stack, under patient-grouped outer folds with inner cross-fitted thresholds and patient-resampled confidence intervals.
  Results: The zero-shot LLM reached macro kappa = 0.139 (95% CI 0.111-0.164). The supervised classifier reached kappa = 0.227 (0.186-0.262), a paired improvement of 0.088 (0.051-0.119). A logistic stack of the two reached kappa = 0.242 (0.198-0.284). We identified multiple corpus-specific leakage paths, including grouping sibling recordings separately and allowing labels from an outer held-out patient to enter few-shot exemplars used while fitting downstream models.
  Conclusion: Zero-shot prompting alone is not sufficient to measure SDM behavior as reliably as a small supervised model, and patient-level grouping alone does not prevent leakage when labeled prompt exemplars are precomputed outside the outer evaluation loop. Reported performance is sensitive to the unit of data splitting and to where labeled exemplars enter the pipeline. External validation is needed before these findings generalize beyond this population, model, prompt, and codebook.

</details>


### [220] [Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14797)
*Haoran Wang,Xiongxiao Xu,Philip S. Yu,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于LLM/LVLM解码方法的综述：重点解释如何在推理时通过token级、序列级和并行生成等方式控制输出，以更高效地提升对齐性与生成速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型和大视觉语言模型生成能力强，但输出与用户意图对齐仍然困难；现有很多方法依赖训练阶段调整，而推理阶段的解码方法更高效、更具可扩展性。

Method: 通过对近期面向LLMs与LVLMs的解码方法研究进行系统性综述，按三种新兴范式归纳：基于token级引导的选择控制、基于序列级生成的控制，以及并行生成以加速推理的方法。

Result: 论文系统梳理了近期解码方法研究，识别出三种新兴范式，总结其优点、应用场景、持续存在的挑战，并讨论未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 本文认为解码方法是提升LLM/LVLM输出与用户意图对齐的一条高效且可扩展的推理阶段路径，并总结了其三类新兴范式、挑战与未来方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive generative capabilities, yet ensuring their outputs align with user intent is still challenging. While most existing approaches address this issue at the training stage, inference-time approaches like decoding methods offer a more efficient and scalable solution. Decoding methods control model generation by guiding token-level selection, performing sequence-level generation, or generating tokens in parallel to accelerate the process. In this survey, we identify three emerging paradigms from recent works on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs, provide a systematic review of these methods, highlight ongoing challenges, and discuss potential future research directions. Our goal is to underscore the efficiency and effectiveness of decoding methods and offer a practical view of their applications. Paper lists and more resources on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs can be found at https://github.com/wang2226/Awesome-LLM-Decoding.

</details>


### [221] [Beyond the pale: Assessing prevalence and contents of extremist speech in LLM training data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14813)
*Dmitry Nikolaev,Ashley A. Mattheis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文检查开源大模型训练语料 Dolma，发现其中可能混入大量极端主义和仇恨内容，说明训练数据清洗与预训练前的数据治理仍然不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前可信与安全AI研究更多关注模型行为，而较少关注LLM在预训练和后训练阶段接触到的文本语料组成；作者希望回答LLM是否会接触到未经过滤、缺乏语境的极端主义言论。

Method: 基于来自官方文件和研究文献的多种极端主义言论定义，结合自动文本处理与专家复核的提取流程，对开源训练语料 Dolma 中的相关文档进行筛查，并给出极端主义文档比例的下界估计。

Result: 研究指出，Dolma 语料中可能包含数十万篇含有极端主义内容和多类仇恨言论的文档，其中包括直接煽动暴力的文本。

Conclusion: 作者认为，大型语言模型训练数据中确实可能包含大量未经过滤、缺乏上下文的极端主义与仇恨内容，这对数据治理与预训练安全提出了直接挑战。

Abstract: Despite a strong interest on the part of the research community in the topic of trustworthy and safe AI, the composition of the text corpora that large language models (LLMs) encounter in pre- and post-training has not yet drawn much attention. In this work, we address the question of whether LLMs are exposed to unfiltered, uncontextualised extremist speech. Using several definitions of extremist speech, stemming from official documents and research literature, and an extraction pipeline combining automated text processing with expert verification, we provide a lower bound on the prevalence of extremist documents in Dolma, an open training corpus underpinning the OLMo series of models. We show that Dolma is likely to include hundreds of thousands of documents containing extremist content and hate speech of several types, including direct calls for violence, and discuss the implications of this for data curation and model pre-training.

</details>


### [222] [Writing Style Similarity Reflects Academic Genealogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14843)
*Cameron Manzo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这项研究表明，论文写作风格会通过导师传承给学生，甚至同门之间也会相似，导致作者归因系统更容易把文章误判到导师或同门身上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者身份归因系统假设每位作者风格独立，但研究生/导师关系与学术同门可能共享写作风格，导致系统误判并对合法作者造成指控风险。

Method: 基于 Mathematics Genealogy Project 图构建 arXiv 数学领域语料库，筛选至少有 2 篇独著论文的作者，共 5,803 名作者与 2,501 对真实导师-学生配对；使用微调模型及两个开源编码器提取论文/作者嵌入，比较导师-学生、学术同门、同机构同领域但无师承关系等配对的余弦距离，并在闭集归因任务中统计错误归属对象。

Result: 微调模型下导师与学生在嵌入空间中比随机同领域作者更接近 39.9%；两个开源编码器也分别复现了 12.6% 和 14.5% 的更近现象。学术同门在 8,360 对样本中也比随机同领域作者更近 30.4%，即使他们在不同机构学习也是如此；仅共享机构和领域的配对相似度不显著。闭集归因中，系统把错误更多地分配给真实作者的导师和学术同门，频率比随机高 11 倍。

Conclusion: 作者风格并非完全独立，师承关系和学术传承会显著影响写作表示，现有身份归因系统会系统性地偏向导师与同门作为误判对象，因此在学术不端检测中存在结构性偏差与误伤风险。

Abstract: As authorship attribution systems are increasingly deployed to detect ghostwritten and AI-generated papers, their errors can support accusations against legitimate authors. These systems assume each author's style is their own. Researchers, however, study under advisors, and inherit their stylistic quirks. We build a corpus of arXiv authors with $\geq 2$ solo papers from the Mathematics Genealogy Project graph, giving $5{,}803$ total authors and $2{,}501$ ground-truth advisor-student pairings. Using embeddings from a fine-tuned model, advisors sit $39.9\%$ closer in cosine distance to their students than a random same-field author does. Two open encoders reproduce the effect at $12.6\%$ and $14.5\%$. \emph{Academic siblings}, two students of one advisor who may never have met, sit $30.4\%$ closer across $8{,}360$ pairs, even when they studied at different institutions. Pairs who share only an institution and a field show negligible similarity. Given a closed-set attribution task over the same corpus, the system's errors occur on the true author's advisors and academic siblings $11$ times more often than chance.

</details>


### [223] [What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14855)
*Animesh Jha,Arpandeep Khatua,Youssef Allouah,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这篇论文研究机器遗忘中的“忘记集策划”问题，提出 CleanSlate 基准，发现 forget set 的选取比遗忘算法本身更关键：选得保守，遗忘不彻底；选得激进，副作用更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的语言模型遗忘请求通常只给出要停止生成的行为或内容，而不知道哪些训练片段、文档、引文或近重复样本支撑了这种行为，因此需要研究如何从抑制请求出发构造遗忘数据集。

Method: 提出 CleanSlate 基准，用于评估针对歌曲和书籍的逐字输出抑制。该基准结合了模型特定的提取画像、内容驱动的问答任务以及能力保留评估，用来比较不同的 forget set 生成策略。

Result: 实验表明，基于自然词汇或精确子串的策划方式往往生成效果较弱的 forget set，导致抑制不充分；而评估感知的策划方式可以几乎完全抑制目标续写，但会带来对非请求内容的性能回退和模型相关的能力损失。

Conclusion: 论文指出，机器遗忘的关键不只是“如何遗忘”，还包括“遗忘什么数据”。忘记集的选择会同时决定抑制效果与模型能力损失，因此遗忘问题本质上包含上游的数据策划问题。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted data or behaviors from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Yet most evaluations assume that the examples to forget are already known.
